_comment: Places to eat, from a shared Google Maps list (scripts/google-list.mjs) and Paris Restaurant Week (restaurantweek.fr, 1–15 Nov 2026), each checked against its own pages, the MICHELIN Guide 2026 and the press in November 2026. Tier = category (A Michelin & Restaurant Week, B everyday, C cafés and sweets); cost = price level; award = Michelin distinction; the theme restaurant-week marks the event. 餐厅条目：A 米其林与餐厅周，B 日常餐厅，C 咖啡与甜点；cost 为价位，award 为米其林评级；主题 restaurant-week 表示参加餐厅周。

items.name: Arpège
items.subtitle: Plant-based haute cuisine
items.why: Alain Passard's three-star restaurant, cooking only plants since July 2025. The menus follow the harvest from his own kitchen gardens in western France.
items.whyZh: Alain Passard 的三星餐厅，2025 年 7 月起只做纯植物料理。菜单跟着他在法国西部自家菜园的收成走。
items.price: Lunch menu €260; dinner menu €380; also à la carte
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐 €260；晚餐套餐 €380；也可单点
items.note: Book online through the website (Zenchef).
items.noteZh: 通过官网（Zenchef）在线预订。

items.name: Kei
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Kei Kobayashi's three-star restaurant in the 1st: French cooking with Japanese precision, built around top produce such as lobster over binchotan and aged Galician beef.
items.whyZh: Kei Kobayashi 的三星餐厅，位于 1 区。法式料理加上日式的精准，围绕顶级食材，比如备长炭烤龙虾和熟成加利西亚牛肉。
items.price: Seven-course menu in several versions, about €280–580
items.priceZh: 七道菜套餐分几个档次，约 €280–580
items.note: Bookings open two months ahead, on the first Tuesday of each month at 09:30.
items.noteZh: 每月第一个周二 09:30 开放未来两个月的预订。

items.name: Alliance
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: Chef Toshitaka Omiya's seasonal surprise menus, with quiet Japanese touches, in a small room that looks onto the kitchen. Two Michelin stars since 2026; Shawn Joyeux runs the dining room.
items.whyZh: 主厨 Toshitaka Omiya 按季节设计惊喜菜单，带着低调的日式细节；餐厅不大，可以看到厨房。2026 年获评米其林二星，前厅由 Shawn Joyeux 主理。
items.price: Menus €145–245 (four to seven courses); lunch from €95
items.note: Only eight tables: book well ahead on TheFork via the website.
items.noteZh: 只有八张桌子，请尽早通过官网（TheFork）预订。

items.name: Blanc
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: Shinichi Sato, formerly of Passage 53, serves seasonal tasting menus in a round dining room in the 16th. Precise cooking of top produce, a Burgundy-led wine list and a whisky bar.
items.whyZh: 曾任 Passage 53 主厨的 Shinichi Sato 在 16 区一间圆形餐厅里供应时令品鉴菜单。顶级食材、手法精准，酒单以勃艮第为主，还有威士忌吧。
items.price: Saturday lunch €180; tasting menus €290, €360 and €450
items.note: Book online or by phone. Lunch is on Saturdays only.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。午餐仅周六供应。

items.name: Le Clarence
items.subtitle: Creative haute cuisine
items.why: Lavish haute cuisine in an 1884 mansion just off the Champs-Élysées. Andrea Capasso took over from Christophe Pelé in 2025 and kept both stars.
items.whyZh: 在香榭丽舍大街旁一座 1884 年的私人宅邸里享用奢华的高级法餐。Andrea Capasso 于 2025 年接替 Christophe Pelé 掌厨，保住了两颗星。
items.price: Lunch menu €150 (Tue–Fri); other menus €250–380 at lunch, €280–430 at dinner
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐 €150（周二至周五）；其他套餐午餐 €250–380，晚餐 €280–430
items.note: Book online; cancelling less than 24 hours ahead costs €150–250 a head.
items.noteZh: 可在网上预订；24 小时内取消每人收取 €150–250。

items.name: David Toutain
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: Inventive surprise menus built on seasonal produce from small growers, in a calm, loft-like room in the 7th. The one-hour lunch menu is the easiest way in.
items.whyZh: 以小农户时令食材为基础的创意惊喜菜单，餐厅在 7 区，是安静的 loft 风格空间。一小时的午餐套餐最容易入门。
items.price: Lunch menus €108–258; dinner menus €258 and €398
items.note: Book online (TheFork) and mention any dietary needs.
items.noteZh: 通过 TheFork 在线预订，并注明饮食禁忌。

items.name: Hakuba
items.subtitle: Kaiseki-style sushi
items.why: Two-star sushi at the Cheval Blanc hotel: Takuya Watanabe makes sushi in front of you, with sauces and broths by Arnaud Donckele and desserts by Maxime Frédéric.
items.whyZh: 白马庄园（Cheval Blanc）酒店内的米其林二星寿司餐厅：Takuya Watanabe 当面捏寿司，Arnaud Donckele 负责酱汁与高汤，甜点出自 Maxime Frédéric。
items.price: Set dinner menu only; well over €100 a head (Michelin €€€€)
items.priceZh: 仅供晚餐套餐；人均远超 €100（米其林 €€€€）
items.note: Book directly with the hotel.
items.noteZh: 需直接向酒店预订。

items.name: Sushi Yoshinaga
items.subtitle: Omakase sushi
items.why: A ten-seat counter where Tomoyuki Yoshinaga serves an omakase of very fresh fish, including several cuts of fatty tuna, with his own marinades and soy sauces. Allow about two hours.
items.whyZh: 只有十个座位的吧台，主厨 Tomoyuki Yoshinaga 奉上无菜单寿司，鱼料极新鲜，有好几种金枪鱼腹，腌汁和酱油都是自制。一餐约两小时。
items.price: Omakase about €330
items.priceZh: 无菜单套餐约 €330
items.note: Book well ahead, online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 需尽早在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Accents Table Bourse
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Japanese pastry chef Ayumi Sugiyama and chef Romain Mahi run this one-star restaurant by the Bourse. Set menus of modern French cooking with smoky, roasted flavours; the desserts are the highlight.
items.whyZh: 日本甜点师 Ayumi Sugiyama 和主厨 Romain Mahi 在交易所旁开的米其林一星餐厅。现代法餐套餐带烟熏和炙烤风味，甜点是亮点。
items.price: Lunch €65 (4 courses) or €100 (6); dinner €150 (7 courses); wine pairing €85 or €115
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Amâlia
items.subtitle: Modern French, Italian touches
items.subtitleZh: 带意式风格的现代法餐
items.why: Two Italian chefs cook refined French tasting menus with Italian touches, one built around vegetables. The room is classic and elegant, with tablecloths, which is rare in this part of Paris.
items.whyZh: 两位意大利主厨做精致的法式品鉴套餐，融入意式元素，其中一款以蔬菜为主。餐厅古典优雅，铺着桌布，在巴黎东部少见。
items.address: 32 Rue de la Fontaine au Roi, 75011 Paris
items.price: Two tasting menus, €160 each
items.priceZh: 两款品鉴套餐，均为 €160
items.note: Book online. Dinner Wed–Sun; lunch on Sundays only.
items.noteZh: 可在官网预订。周三至周日供应晚餐，午餐仅限周日。

items.name: Restaurant AT
items.subtitle: Creative French-Japanese
items.why: A small, minimal room near the Seine where Atsushi Tanaka, formerly with Pierre Gagnaire, serves one seasonal tasting menu. Precise, surprising dishes that join French technique with Japanese and Nordic ideas.
items.whyZh: 塞纳河附近一间简约的小餐厅，曾在 Pierre Gagnaire 门下工作的 Atsushi Tanaka 只做一套时令品鉴菜单。菜式精准又出人意料，以法式技法结合日本和北欧的灵感。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's lunch or dinner, 13 courses, €175 (usually €195); chef's lunch, 9 courses, €121 (usually €135); chef's lunch, 7 courses, €76 (usually €85). Usually: weekday lunch menu €85 (seven courses); tasting menus €135 (nine courses) and €195 (13 courses).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨午餐或晚餐13道 €175（平时 €195）；主厨午餐9道 €121（平时 €135）；主厨午餐7道 €76（平时 €85）。平时：工作日午餐套餐 €85（七道）；品鉴菜单 €135（九道）和 €195（十三道）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book on the restaurant's website or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可在餐厅官网或电话预订。

items.name: Auguste
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: A small, calm room near the Invalides for polished modern cooking by Gaël Orieux, who uses market produce and only non-endangered fish. The lunch menu is good value.
items.whyZh: 荣军院附近一间安静的小餐厅，Gaël Orieux 做精致的现代法餐，用市场食材，只选非濒危鱼种。午餐套餐性价比高。
items.price: Lunch menu €47; menus €96 and €120; à la carte mains €54–65
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Baieta
items.subtitle: Modern Niçoise
items.why: Julia Sedefdjian cooks bright Mediterranean food from her native Nice, in the 5th near Maubert. Her take on bouillabaisse, the Bouillabaieta, is the signature.
items.whyZh: Julia Sedefdjian 做家乡尼斯风味的地中海料理，明快清新，餐厅在 5 区莫贝尔广场附近。招牌是她改良的马赛鱼汤 Bouillabaieta。
items.price: Weekday lunch €65; menus €110, €130 and €155
items.note: Book online or by phone. The €65 lunch is weekdays only.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。€65 午餐仅限工作日。

items.name: Datil
items.subtitle: Plant-led modern French
items.subtitleZh: 以蔬菜为主的现代法餐
items.why: Manon Fleury's mostly plant-based tasting menus, with vegetables, grains and fruit at the centre and meat or fish used sparingly. Local sourcing and zero waste; it also holds a Michelin Green Star.
items.whyZh: Manon Fleury 的品鉴菜单以蔬菜、谷物和水果为主，肉和鱼用得很少。注重本地采购和零浪费，还获得了米其林绿星。
items.price: Lunch tasting menu €95 (5 courses); dinner €160 (7 courses)
items.priceZh: 午餐品鉴菜单 €95（5 道）；晚餐 €160（7 道）
items.note: Booking is essential; book online (Zenchef) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 必须预订，可在网上（Zenchef）或电话订位。

items.name: Episodes
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: Guillaume Goupil, a Meilleur Ouvrier de France, cooks a precise, modern tasting menu of five or seven courses for just 16 guests. Dinner only, in the former OKA.
items.whyZh: 法国最佳手工业者（MOF）Guillaume Goupil 为仅 16 位客人做精准的现代品鉴套餐，分五道和七道。只做晚餐，前身是 OKA。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Dinner, 5 courses, €123 (usually €145). Usually: tasting menus €145 (5 courses) and €195 (7 courses); wine pairings €95 and €115.
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Only 16 seats and dinner only: book ahead online.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。只有 16 个座位且只做晚餐，请提前在网上预订。

items.name: Fleur de pavé
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Sylvain Sendra's one-star restaurant near the Bourse. Modern French cooking with ideas from around the world, vegetables from Asafumi Yamashita's garden and a wine list full of rare bottles.
items.whyZh: Sylvain Sendra 的米其林一星餐厅，靠近交易所。现代法餐融入世界各地的灵感，蔬菜来自 Asafumi Yamashita 的菜园，酒单里有不少稀有酒款。
items.price: Weekday lunch €65 (4 courses); weekday dinner €80 (4 courses); tasting menu €135 (6 courses)
items.priceZh: 工作日午餐 €65（4 道）；工作日晚餐 €80（4 道）；品尝套餐 €135（6 道）
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Géosmine
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: A two-storey townhouse near Oberkampf where Maxime Bouttier serves a seasonal tasting menu of precise, pared-back dishes. The wine list leans towards natural and biodynamic bottles.
items.whyZh: Oberkampf 附近的一栋两层小楼，Maxime Bouttier 主理时令品鉴菜单，菜式精准简洁。酒单偏重自然酒和生物动力酒。
items.address: 71 Rue de la Folie Méricourt, 75011 Paris
items.price: Carte blanche menu: €80 at lunch, €140 at dinner
items.priceZh: 主厨自选菜单：午餐 €80，晚餐 €140
items.note: Book ahead.
items.noteZh: 建议提前预订。

items.name: Maison Avoise
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Refined seasonal cooking under the stone vaults of the old fort at Issy-les-Moulineaux. The chef trained with Alléno, Piège and Savoy; veal sweetbreads are the signature dish.
items.whyZh: 在伊西莱穆利诺旧要塞的石拱厅里吃精致的时令料理。主厨曾在 Alléno、Piège 和 Savoy 的厨房工作，招牌菜是小牛胸腺。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Avoise menu, 8 courses with a welcome cocktail, €150. Usually: lunch menu €64 (Tue–Fri); six courses €110, eight courses €150.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：Avoise 菜单8道，配迎宾鸡尾酒 €150。平时：午餐套餐 €64（周二至周五）；六道式 €110，八道式 €150。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online (TheFork) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可通过 TheFork 网上预订或电话预订。

items.name: NHOME
items.subtitle: Creative tasting menu
items.why: A ten-course tasting menu in a vaulted cellar opposite the Palais-Royal. Creative cooking with Nordic, Japanese and Middle Eastern touches, using charcoal and fermentation.
items.whyZh: 在皇家宫殿对面的拱顶地窖里吃十道菜的品鉴菜单。创意料理带北欧、日本和中东风味，善用炭火与发酵。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Tasting menu, 10 courses, €136 (usually €155); lunch, 5 courses with a cheese plate on the house, €90. Usually: 10-course tasting menu €155; wine pairing €90.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：品鉴菜单10道 €136（平时 €155）；午餐5道，赠奶酪拼盘 €90。平时：十道菜品鉴菜单 €155；配酒 €90。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Omar Dhiab
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Young chef Omar Dhiab's one-star restaurant near Place des Victoires. Precise modern French cooking, with some sauces and spices of Egyptian origin, in a minimalist room with an open kitchen.
items.whyZh: 年轻主厨 Omar Dhiab 的米其林一星餐厅，靠近胜利广场。现代法餐做得精准，部分酱汁和香料带埃及风味；店内极简，厨房开放。
items.price: Lunch €72 (3 courses), €88 (4) or €128 (5); 7-course menu €168; à la carte at dinner
items.note: Book on the website, by email or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可通过官网、邮件或电话预订。

items.name: L'Ours
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: Jacky Ribault's own kitchen in Vincennes, just east of Paris. Generous set menus built on top produce and his Breton roots, with light Japanese touches and some raw dishes.
items.whyZh: Jacky Ribault 亲自掌勺的餐厅，在紧邻巴黎东边的 Vincennes。套餐分量足，以顶级食材和他的布列塔尼背景为底，带一点日本元素，也有生食料理。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Dinner, 6 courses with cheese, water and coffee, €150; lunch, 3 courses with cheese, water and coffee, €70. Usually: lunch €70 (3 courses, Tue–Fri) or €130 (5); dinner €90 (3 courses, Tue–Thu), €170 (6) or €270 (8).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：晚餐6道，含奶酪、饮用水和咖啡 €150；午餐3道，含奶酪、饮用水和咖啡 €70。平时：午餐 €70（3 道，周二至周五）或 €130（5 道）；晚餐 €90（3 道，周二至周四）、€170（6 道）或 €270（8 道）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Menus are for the whole table; book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。整桌需点同一套餐；可在网上或打电话预订。

items.name: Pantagruel
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Jason Gouzy's playful, precise modern cooking, where each course comes as three matching small dishes. Now in a colourful room by the Palais-Royal gardens.
items.whyZh: Jason Gouzy 的现代法餐俏皮又精准，每道菜都由三小份相互呼应的菜组成。餐厅已搬到皇家宫殿花园旁，装潢色彩缤纷。
items.price: Lunch menu €65; 5-course menu €135; 6-course menu €189
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐 €65；五道菜套餐 €135；六道菜套餐 €189
items.note: Book online; cancel at least 24 hours ahead.
items.noteZh: 可在网上预订；如需取消请至少提前 24 小时。

items.name: Qui Plume la Lune
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Jacky Ribault's Michelin-starred restaurant near Bastille, now cooked by his long-time sous-chef Lorenzo De Girolamo. Seasonal, carefully plated set menus in two rooms, one with bare stone and natural materials.
items.whyZh: Jacky Ribault 在巴士底附近的米其林一星餐厅，现由跟随他多年的副主厨 Lorenzo De Girolamo 掌勺。时令套餐摆盘用心；两间餐室风格不同，其中一间是石墙和天然材质。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Dinner, 5 courses with cheese, water and coffee, €120; lunch, 3 courses with cheese, water and coffee, €70. Usually: set menus €70 (3 courses), €110 (5), €150 (6) and €250.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：晚餐5道，含奶酪、饮用水和咖啡 €120；午餐3道，含奶酪、饮用水和咖啡 €70。平时：套餐 €70（3 道）、€110（5 道）、€150（6 道）和 €250。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。

items.name: Quinsou
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: Antonin Bonnet's starred restaurant, opposite the Ferrandi cookery school. Simple-looking, produce-led set menus, and a duck and foie gras pâté en croûte that changes with the seasons.
items.whyZh: Antonin Bonnet 的米其林一星餐厅，就在 Ferrandi 厨艺学校对面。套餐看似简单，重在食材；鸭肉鹅肝酥皮肉派随季节变化，是招牌菜。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's dinner, 7 courses with signature cocktails, €105 (usually €125). Usually: dinner menus €95 and €125; lunch €39–58 (Thu–Fri), signature lunch €95.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨晚餐7道，配招牌鸡尾酒 €105（平时 €125）。平时：晚餐套餐 €95 和 €125；午餐 €39–58（周四至周五），招牌午餐 €95。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online on the restaurant's website.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可在餐厅官网在线预订。

items.name: Septime
items.subtitle: Modern French tasting menu
items.why: A neo-bistro near Rue de Charonne, starred since 2014. A surprise menu of light, vegetable-led cooking, with natural wines.
items.whyZh: 夏洪街附近的新派小酒馆，2014 年起获米其林一星。无菜单套餐清爽、以蔬菜为主，配自然酒。
items.price: Dinner carte blanche menu €135 (seven courses); lunch €85 (five courses); wine pairing €75 at dinner, €60 at lunch
items.priceZh: 晚餐无菜单套餐 €135（七道）；午餐 €85（五道）；配酒晚餐 €75，午餐 €60
items.note: Bookings open online at 10:00 each day for the next three weeks and go fast.
items.noteZh: 每天 10:00 在网上开放未来三周的预订，很快订满。

items.name: Substance
items.subtitle: Creative Franco-Italian
items.why: A starred restaurant in the 16th, now run by the Roman duo Flavio Lucarini (savoury) and Aurora Storari (desserts). Lively Franco-Italian tasting menus, including a vegetarian one.
items.whyZh: 第十六区的米其林一星餐厅，现由罗马搭档 Flavio Lucarini（咸食）和 Aurora Storari（甜点）主理。法意融合的品鉴菜单活泼有趣，也有素食套餐。
items.price: Lunch menus €68 and €98; tasting menus €138 (vegetarian), €158 and €188
items.note: Book online (TheFork) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上（TheFork）或电话预订。

items.name: Vaisseau
items.subtitle: Creative tasting menu
items.why: Adrien Cachot's dark, intimate restaurant, starred since 2025. A blind carte blanche of bold, playful dishes, often with offal; you find out what you ate afterwards.
items.whyZh: Adrien Cachot 的餐厅，空间幽暗私密，2025 年获米其林一星。无菜单盲品套餐，菜式大胆有趣，常用内脏入菜，吃完才揭晓是什么。
items.price: Lunch menus €60 and €120; dinner menus €120 and €180; drinks pairing €40–100
items.note: Book only through the official website (Zenchef); fake booking sites exist.
items.noteZh: 只能通过官网（Zenchef）预订，网上有假冒订位网站。

items.name: Ze Kitchen Galerie
items.subtitle: French-Asian fusion
items.why: William Ledeuil's long-running restaurant near the Seine, pairing French cooking with Southeast Asian herbs and spices: broths, pasta, fish and plancha dishes. Lunch is the best value.
items.whyZh: William Ledeuil 开了多年的餐厅，靠近塞纳河，把法餐与东南亚香草香料结合：清汤、意面、鱼和铁板菜。午餐最划算。
items.price: Lunch €43–49; tasting menus €105 (5 courses) and €125 (7 courses)
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Zostera
items.subtitle: Creative seafood
items.why: Julien Dumas, formerly of Lucas Carton, cooks mainly fish and shellfish, with vegetables given just as much care. Tasting menus in a quiet, elegant room; it won its first Michelin star in 2026.
items.whyZh: 曾任 Lucas Carton 主厨的 Julien Dumas 以鱼类和贝类为主，蔬菜也同样讲究。安静雅致的餐厅里提供品鉴套餐，2026 年首次获得米其林一星。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Dinner, 6 courses with a glass of champagne on the house, €99. Usually: lunch menu €65 (4 courses); tasting menus €99 (5 courses), €135 (7) and €185 (9).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：晚餐6道，赠一杯香槟 €99。平时：午餐套餐 €65（4 道）；品鉴套餐 €99（5 道）、€135（7 道）和 €185（9 道）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Weekdays only; book online.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。仅工作日营业，请在网上预订。

items.name: Le Caillebotte
items.subtitle: Neo-bistro
items.why: A bright bistro from the Le Pantruche team, with an open kitchen. Inventive, generous seasonal plates at fair prices.
items.whyZh: Le Pantruche 团队开的明亮小酒馆，开放式厨房。时令菜有新意、分量足，价格公道。
items.price: Lunch menu €23, dinner menu €43 (2024 prices)
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐 €23，晚餐套餐 €43（2024 年价格）
items.note: Book online or by phone; no tables for more than six.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订；不接受 6 人以上订位。

items.name: Mova
items.subtitle: Modern French bistro
items.why: A Bib Gourmand bistro on rue des Dames where François Merle cooks seasonal vegetables and fish with care. Weekly-changing lunch menu; short tasting menus at night.
items.whyZh: rue des Dames 上的米其林必比登小酒馆，主厨 François Merle 用心烹调时令蔬菜和鱼。午餐每周换菜单，晚餐是简短的品鉴套餐。
items.price: Lunch €24–30 (two or three courses); dinner menus €45 (four courses) and €69 (six courses)
items.priceZh: 午餐 €24–30（两道或三道）；晚餐套餐 €45（四道）和 €69（六道）
items.note: Book by phone or through the website.
items.noteZh: 可电话或通过官网预订。

items.name: Baillotte
items.subtitle: Modern French, Japanese touch
items.why: French cooking with Japanese precision from Satoshi Amitsu, formerly with Georges Blanc. A fair-priced lunch menu for Saint-Germain and good wines by the glass.
items.whyZh: 曾在 Georges Blanc 工作的 Satoshi Amitsu 以日式的精准做法式料理。在圣日耳曼算是价格公道的午市套餐，单杯酒也选得好。
items.price: Lunch menu €33–39; dinner à la carte, dishes €16–30
items.priceZh: 午市套餐 €33–39；晚餐单点，菜品 €16–30

items.name: Benjamin Schmitt
items.subtitle: Modern French bistro
items.why: Benjamin Schmitt, who trained at Le Meurice and Taillevent, runs his first restaurant near Pigalle. Seasonal French cooking from local produce that moves between classic and modern, such as pâté en croûte or guinea fowl.
items.whyZh: 曾在 Le Meurice 和 Taillevent 历练的 Benjamin Schmitt 在 Pigalle 附近开的第一家餐厅。用本地食材做时令法国菜，在传统与现代之间切换，比如酥皮肉派和珍珠鸡。
items.address: 43 Rue Catherine de la Rochefoucauld 75009 Paris
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's menu, 5 courses with a glass of wine, €75 (usually €80). Usually: weekday lunch menu about €30; 5-course chef's menu about €70–80; à la carte at dinner.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨菜单5道，配一杯葡萄酒 €75（平时 €80）。平时：工作日午餐套餐约 €30；五道式主厨套餐约 €70–80；晚餐也可单点。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。

items.name: CABANE
items.subtitle: Bistronomy
items.why: Generous, seasonal bistro cooking in Nanterre from a chef who worked at the George V and the Shangri-La. Good value, and a Michelin inspectors' favourite.
items.whyZh: Nanterre 的新派小酒馆，主厨曾在 George V 和 Shangri-La 任职。菜量足、跟着季节走，性价比高，也是米其林评审员推荐的餐厅。
items.price: Starter, main and dessert €49; weekday lunch €37 (two courses)
items.priceZh: 前菜、主菜加甜点 €49；工作日午餐两道菜 €37
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Café des Ministères
items.subtitle: Classic French bistro
items.why: A smart, old-style bistro near the Assemblée nationale, run by Jean and Roxane Sévègnes. Known for vol-au-vent with veal sweetbreads, stuffed cabbage and rich sauces, with a well-chosen French wine list.
items.whyZh: 国民议会附近一家讲究的老派小酒馆，由 Jean 和 Roxane Sévègnes 夫妇打理。招牌是小牛胸腺酥盒和酿卷心菜，酱汁浓郁，法国葡萄酒单也选得用心。
items.price: À la carte about €50–75; starters €8–23, mains €23–47
items.note: Book two to three weeks ahead.
items.noteZh: 需提前两三周预订。

items.name: Calice
items.subtitle: Franco-Japanese bistro
items.why: A bistro by the Rue Mouffetard market mixing French produce and Japanese flavours: a set lunch, then small plates and binchotan-grilled cuts to share at night. Natural wines and sake by the glass.
items.whyZh: Mouffetard 市集附近的小酒馆，用法国食材做日式风味：午餐是套餐，晚上是分享小盘和备长炭烤肉、烤鱼。有自然酒和单杯清酒。
items.price: Lunch formula €28, menu €34; evening small plates €14–21
items.note: Book online via the website.
items.noteZh: 可通过官网在线预订。

items.name: Charbon Kunitoraya
items.subtitle: Yakitori tasting menus
items.why: Bresse chicken yakitori grilled over binchotan charcoal, from the team behind the Kunitoraya udon restaurants. Tasting menus at dinner; lunch sets with bento and udon cost much less.
items.whyZh: 用备长炭烤布雷斯鸡肉串，出自 Kunitoraya 乌冬面馆的团队。晚餐是品尝套餐；午餐有便当和乌冬套餐，便宜得多。
items.price: Dinner menus €180 and €250 (omakase); lunch menus €45–110; à la carte too
items.priceZh: 晚餐套餐 €180 和 €250（无菜单料理）；午餐套餐 €45–110；也可单点
items.note: Book online on the restaurant's website.
items.noteZh: 可在餐厅官网在线预订。

items.name: Chenapan
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: A tiny bistro near Pigalle with an open kitchen, run by two alumni of Ze Kitchen Galerie. Playful set menus with Asian touches change with what the producers bring.
items.whyZh: 皮加勒附近的小餐馆，开放式厨房，两位主理人都出自 Ze Kitchen Galerie。套餐俏皮、带亚洲风味，随供应商送来的食材而变。
items.address: 28 Rue Louise-Émilie de la Tour d'Auvergne, 75009 Paris
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's dinner, 6 courses with a signature dessert, €98; chef's lunch, 5 courses with a signature dessert, €79. Usually: three-course menu €59; five courses €79 at lunch, €98 at dinner.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨晚餐6道，配招牌甜点 €98；主厨午餐5道，配招牌甜点 €79。平时：三道式套餐 €59；五道式午餐 €79，晚餐 €98。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Only about 18 seats: book ahead.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。只有约 18 个座位，建议提前预订。

items.name: Dessance
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Argentine chef Javier Oliva serves two six-course carte blanche menus, one with fish and meat and one vegetarian, in a Marais mansion that feels like a winter garden. Seasonal vegetables, fruit and herbs lead, and the wines lean natural and biodynamic.
items.whyZh: 阿根廷主厨 Javier Oliva 提供两套六道式主厨自选菜单，一套有鱼有肉，一套素食；餐厅在玛黑区一座老宅里，像个冬季花园。菜式以时令蔬果和香草为主，酒单偏重自然酒和生物动力酒。
items.hoursZh: 午餐周四至周六 12:00–14:00；晚餐周二至周六 18:30 起
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's lunch or dinner, 6 courses, €69 (usually €82). Usually: six-course menus €82 (fish and meat, or vegetarian); wine pairing €44.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨午餐或晚餐6道 €69（平时 €82）。平时：六道式套餐 €82（海陆或素食）；配酒 €44。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online (Zenchef) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可通过 Zenchef 在线预订或电话预订。

items.name: Eels
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Precise modern French cooking from a former William Ledeuil cook, in a stone-walled room with a counter facing the open kitchen. The smoked eel starter gives the place its name.
items.whyZh: 主厨师从 William Ledeuil，做精准的现代法餐。石墙餐厅里有正对开放式厨房的吧台座，店名来自招牌前菜烟熏鳗鱼。
items.price: Lunch €32–39; tasting menu €89; à la carte mains €33–48
items.priceZh: 午市套餐 €32–39；品鉴套餐 €89；单点主菜 €33–48

items.name: Restaurant ERH
items.subtitle: French-Japanese
items.why: Chef Ryuichi Utsumi cooks French produce with Japanese technique in set menus, served at a counter facing the open kitchen under a glass roof. It is at the back of La Maison du Saké, with a long, fairly priced sake list.
items.whyZh: 主厨 Ryuichi Utsumi 用日式手法处理法国食材，做多道式套餐；座位是玻璃天棚下正对开放式厨房的吧台。餐厅在 La Maison du Saké 清酒店里面，清酒选择多，价格也公道。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Dinner, 9 courses with a glass of sake, €148.50 (usually €165); lunch, 6 courses with sake on the house, €81 (usually €90). Usually: lunch from €65; dinner from €75 (Tue–Thu) to €165 for the 9-course menu; sake pairings from €52.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：晚餐9道，配一杯清酒 €148.50（平时 €165）；午餐6道，赠清酒 €81（平时 €90）。平时：午餐 €65 起；晚餐 €75 起（周二至周四），9 道式套餐 €165；清酒搭配 €52 起。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book ahead online, especially for dinner. Go in through the sake shop.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。建议提前在网上预订，晚餐尤其如此。从清酒店进门。

items.name: Eunoé
items.subtitle: French-Japanese bistro
items.why: A modern bistro by Square Maurice-Gardette where Japanese chef Ryuji Sato cooks generous French dishes with Japanese touches, many grilled over binchotan charcoal. Lunch is a bargain; dinner is more polished.
items.whyZh: Maurice-Gardette 广场旁的现代小酒馆，日本主厨 Ryuji Sato 做分量十足的法国菜，带日式风味，不少菜用备长炭烤制。午餐很划算，晚餐更精致。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's dinner, 4 courses with petits fours, €80 (usually €95); chef's lunch, 5 courses with water, house butter and coffee, €41. Usually: weekday lunch €15 (dish of the day) or €26 (set menu); dinner €35 or €65.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨晚餐4道，配小甜点 €80（平时 €95）；主厨午餐5道，含饮用水、自制黄油和咖啡 €41。平时：工作日午餐 €15（每日菜）或 €26（套餐）；晚餐 €35 或 €65。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Fogo
items.subtitle: French charcoal grill
items.why: The relaxed sister of Episodes, in the same building and run by the same team. Meat, fish and vegetables cooked over embers in an open kitchen, with big cuts such as côte de bœuf to share.
items.whyZh: Episodes 的姊妹店，同一栋楼、同一团队，氛围更轻松。开放式厨房用炭火烤肉、鱼和蔬菜，还有带骨牛肋排这类适合多人分享的大块肉。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: À la carte at lunch or dinner, with a glass of champagne on the house. Usually: lunch menu €40–52 (2 or 3 courses); à la carte starters €9–19, mains €35–59; large cuts to share priced by weight.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：午餐或晚餐单点，赠一杯香槟。平时：午餐套餐 €40–52（两道或三道）；单点前菜 €9–19，主菜 €35–59；分享用的大块肉按重量计价。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。

items.name: Halle aux Grains
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Michel and Sébastien Bras's restaurant on the third floor of the Bourse de Commerce, with views over the rooftops. Grains, seeds and pulses run through the menu, a nod to the building's past as a grain exchange.
items.whyZh: Michel 与 Sébastien Bras 父子在 Bourse de Commerce 美术馆楼上开的餐厅，可俯瞰巴黎屋顶。菜单以谷物、种子和豆类为主线，呼应这座建筑当年作为粮食交易所的历史。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: ‘Balade’ menu, 7 courses with a glass of wine, €118 (usually €137); vegetarian ‘Jardin’ menu, 7 courses with a glass of wine, €98 (usually €117). Usually: lunch menu €57 (3 courses); dinner tasting menus from about €98, or à la carte.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：“Balade”菜单7道，配一杯葡萄酒 €118（平时 €137）；素食“Jardin”菜单7道，配一杯葡萄酒 €98（平时 €117）。平时：午餐套餐 €57（3 道）；晚餐品鉴套餐约 €98 起，也可单点。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book ahead, especially for dinner and weekends.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。建议提前预订，晚餐和周末尤其如此。

items.name: Helen
items.subtitle: Wild fish and seafood
items.why: Wild fish from small boats, bought daily and cooked simply: raw, grilled, steamed or on the plancha. A smart, quiet room near the Champs-Élysées.
items.whyZh: 每天采购小船捕捞的野生鱼，做法简单：生食、炭烤、清蒸或铁板。餐厅雅致安静，靠近香榭丽舍大街。
items.price: 7-course discovery menu €160 (whole table); mains mostly €44–95; fish by weight €100–130/kg
items.priceZh: 七道菜探索套餐 €160（全桌同点）；主菜多为 €44–95；按重量计价的鱼每公斤 €100–130
items.note: Book online (TheFork) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可通过 TheFork 或电话预订。

items.name: jjii
items.subtitle: Modern French-Korean
items.why: Korean chef Jaewook Hur cooks alone in the open kitchen of this narrow room. A surprise menu of French cooking with Korean and Japanese touches, such as sea bass with kimchi.
items.whyZh: 韩国主厨 Jaewook Hur 在狭长小店的开放式厨房里独自掌勺。无菜单套餐以法餐为底，融入韩国和日本风味，比如配泡菜的鲈鱼。
items.price: Carte blanche dinner menu about €68–75
items.priceZh: 晚餐无菜单套餐约 €68–75
items.note: Small room: book ahead on the website or by phone.
items.noteZh: 店面小，建议通过官网或电话提前预订。

items.name: Kalank
items.subtitle: Provençal Mediterranean
items.why: A Marseille-style bistro with straw lamps and bamboo chairs, plus a small deli of southern produce. Provençal food such as panisses with aïoli, stuffed vegetables and artichokes barigoule, with good-value lunches on the terrace.
items.whyZh: 马赛风格的小馆，草编灯配竹椅，还附设一间南法食品铺。做普罗旺斯菜，比如鹰嘴豆炸条配蒜泥蛋黄酱、酿蔬菜和 barigoule 式焖朝鲜蓟；露台午餐很划算。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's menu, 5 courses with a Kalank spritz, €63 (usually €75). Usually: 3 courses €46.50 or 5-course blind tasting menu €67; lunch from a daily blackboard.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨菜单5道，配一杯 Kalank Spritz €63（平时 €75）。平时：三道式 €46.50，或五道式盲品套餐 €67；午餐看每日黑板菜单。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。

items.name: Kitchen Ter(re)
items.subtitle: Asian-accented pasta
items.why: William Ledeuil's pasta house: unusual pastas made from old wheat varieties by baker Roland Feuillas, served with fragrant broths, Asian herbs and spices.
items.whyZh: William Ledeuil 的意面餐厅：用农民面包师 Roland Feuillas 的古老小麦制作特色意面，配上带亚洲香草和香料的清汤。
items.price: Lunch €33–38 (Tue–Fri); dinner starters €19–23, mains €26–37, desserts €13

items.name: Kushikatsu Bon
items.subtitle: Osaka kushikatsu
items.why: Osaka-style kushikatsu: skewers of meat, seafood and vegetables fried in breadcrumbs, served one by one on an omakase menu at dinner. Lunch is simpler.
items.whyZh: 大阪风味串炸：肉、海鲜和蔬菜裹面包糠炸成串，晚餐以无菜单形式一串串上桌。午餐较简单。
items.price: Dinner menu €64
items.priceZh: 晚餐套餐 €64
items.note: Book ahead by phone.
items.noteZh: 建议提前电话预订。

items.name: Maison
items.subtitle: Modern French set menu
items.why: Sota Atsumi cooks a set menu of market produce, much of it in a wood-fired oven, served around a huge shared table in a high-ceilinged loft. Relaxed but serious.
items.whyZh: Sota Atsumi 用市场时令食材做固定套餐，不少菜用柴火烤炉烹制。挑高的工业风阁楼中间摆着一张大长桌，气氛轻松，料理却很认真。
items.price: Lunch menu €85 (Thu–Sat); seven-course menu €175 (dinner and Sunday lunch)
items.priceZh: 午市套餐 €85（周四至周六）；七道菜套餐 €175（晚餐及周日午餐）
items.note: Book ahead online.
items.noteZh: 建议提前在网上预订。

items.name: Montée
items.subtitle: Franco-Japanese
items.why: Kobe-born chef Takayuki Nameura cooks French food with Japanese restraint: pared-back tasting menus with clean, graphic plating, in a calm, stylish room.
items.whyZh: 神户出生的主厨 Takayuki Nameura 用日式的克制做法国菜：品鉴套餐简洁利落，摆盘干净有线条感，餐厅安静雅致。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Dinner, 7 courses, €99 (usually €120); lunch, 5 courses with a glass of wine or sake, €60. Usually: lunch tasting menus €60 (5 courses) and €75 (6); dinner €120 (7 courses) and €150 (10).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：晚餐7道 €99（平时 €120）；午餐5道，配一杯葡萄酒或清酒 €60。平时：午餐品鉴套餐 €60（5 道）和 €75（6 道）；晚餐 €120（7 道）和 €150（10 道）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online, up to 90 days ahead; a card holds the table (€50 a head for late cancellation or no-show).
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。只接受网上预订，最多提前 90 天；需留信用卡担保（临时取消或未到每人收 €50）。

items.name: Oktobre
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: A warm, lively room near Saint-André-des-Arts from Martin Maumet, formerly of Kitchen Galerie Bis. Top produce with spices and Asian touches, such as cuttlefish linguine or pollock with miso butter sauce.
items.whyZh: 圣安德烈艺术街附近的餐厅，气氛温暖热闹，主厨 Martin Maumet 曾在 Kitchen Galerie Bis 掌勺。好食材配香料和亚洲风味，比如墨鱼扁面、味噌黄油汁青鳕。
items.price: Lunch menus €34–49 (Tue–Fri); dinner menu €83; mains €36–45 à la carte
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐 €34–49（周二至周五）；晚餐套餐 €83；单点主菜 €36–45
items.note: Book online via the website.
items.noteZh: 可在官网在线预订。

items.name: Osteria Ferrara
items.subtitle: Italian bistro
items.why: Sicilian chef Fabrizio Ferrara's Italian bistro, with seasonal pasta, risotto and fish and a good Italian wine list. The weekday lunch set is good value.
items.whyZh: 西西里主厨 Fabrizio Ferrara 的意式小馆，做应季意面、烩饭和鱼，意大利酒单很好。工作日午餐套餐很划算。
items.price: Weekday lunch €25–30; dinner menu €63 (5 courses); à la carte mains €24–38
items.priceZh: 工作日午餐 €25–30；晚餐套餐 €63（5 道）；单点主菜 €24–38
items.note: Book online (Zenchef) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上（Zenchef）或电话预订。

items.name: Pétrelle
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: An intimate, romantic room with flea-market charm in the 9th. Fresh, Mediterranean-leaning set menus from a chef who cooked at Le Chateaubriand, and a cellar of more than 300 wines.
items.whyZh: 九区一间私密浪漫的餐厅，带跳蚤市场风格。主厨曾在 Le Chateaubriand 工作，套餐新鲜、偏地中海风味，酒窖有 300 多款酒。
items.price: Lunch €36–52 (weekends); dinner menus €75 (four courses) and €105 (five)
items.note: Few tables: booking advised.
items.noteZh: 桌位有限，建议预订。

items.name: Richer
items.subtitle: Neo-bistro
items.why: A relaxed all-day neighbourhood bistro, open from breakfast to late evening. The short menu changes weekly with the seasons, and there is good Iberian ham and aged cheese.
items.whyZh: 轻松的街区小酒馆，从早餐一直开到深夜。菜单简短，每周随季节更换，伊比利亚火腿和熟成奶酪也不错。
items.price: À la carte: starters €7–19, mains €22–28, desserts €4–12
items.note: You can book on its website or walk in.
items.noteZh: 可在官网预订，也可直接去。

items.name: TOWA
items.subtitle: Classic French cooking
items.why: Near the Aligre market, Japanese chef Shin Okusa cooks French classics with care: lamb navarin, duck breast pithivier, hot pâtés and proper sauces.
items.whyZh: 日本主厨 Shin Okusa 在 Aligre 市场旁认真做法式经典：炖羊肉、鸭胸酥皮派、热肉派和地道酱汁。
items.price: Lunch menu €45; carte blanche menu €97; also à la carte
items.priceZh: 午市套餐 €45；主厨发挥套餐 €97；也可单点

items.name: Vantre
items.subtitle: Neo-bistro
items.why: A neo-bistro run by a former Le Bristol and Taillevent sommelier, with more than 3,000 wines. Chef Masaki Nagao cooks careful seasonal French dishes; the weekday lunch menu is good value.
items.whyZh: 由曾在 Le Bristol 和 Taillevent 任职的侍酒师开的新派小酒馆，酒单超过 3000 款。主厨 Masaki Nagao 做细致的时令法餐，工作日午餐套餐很划算。
items.address: 19 Rue de la Fontaine au Roi, 75011 Paris
items.price: Lunch menu €28; dinner à la carte about €62–82
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐 €28；晚餐单点约 €62–82
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Le Beaucé
items.subtitle: Classic French bistro
items.why: A classic bistro on rue Richer, opened in 2020 by Marius Bénard, formerly chef at QueDuBon. A short market menu of French bistro dishes, offal included, and about 150 wines, many of them natural.
items.whyZh: Richer 街上的传统小酒馆，由曾任 QueDuBon 主厨的 Marius Bénard 于 2020 年开设。菜单简短，随市场变化，都是法式小酒馆菜，也有内脏菜；酒单约 150 款，不少是自然酒。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's lunch or dinner, 4 courses with an aperitif, €50. Usually: lunch €22–25; at dinner, starters €9–14 and mains around €29 (2024 prices).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨午餐或晚餐4道，配开胃酒 €50。平时：午餐 €22–25；晚餐前菜 €9–14，主菜约 €29（2024 年价格）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Café Harcourt
items.subtitle: French café-restaurant
items.why: A café-restaurant inside Studio Harcourt, the famous portrait photography studio, in a mansion in the 16th. Seasonal French cooking at lunch, and dinner on Friday and Saturday evenings.
items.whyZh: 位于著名人像摄影工作室 Studio Harcourt 宅邸里的咖啡餐厅，在 16 区。午餐供应时令法国菜，周五、周六晚上也有晚餐。
items.hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–17:00 (lunch 12:00–14:30); Sat 10:30–17:00 (café and bar only); Fri–Sat dinner 19:00–22:00
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Lunch or dinner, 3 courses with a glass of champagne, €55. Usually: three-course menu with a glass of champagne usually €55.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：午餐或晚餐3道，配一杯香槟 €55。平时：三道式套餐配一杯香槟，平时 €55。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Lunch without booking is possible, but call ahead: the room is sometimes hired for private events.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。午餐可以不订位，但最好先打电话：场地有时会被包场。

items.name: Cagnard
items.subtitle: Mediterranean bistro
items.why: A Mediterranean bistro between Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est, opened in 2025. Chef Félix Barthe borrows from southern France, Italy, Greece, Turkey and Lebanon, with seasonal dishes such as octopus carpaccio, stuffed courgette or lamb tournedos.
items.whyZh: 北站和东站之间的地中海风味小酒馆，2025 年开业。主厨 Félix Barthe 借鉴法国南部、意大利、希腊、土耳其和黎巴嫩的风味，做章鱼薄片、酿西葫芦、小羊里脊等时令菜。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六，午餐和晚餐
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's dinner, 5 courses, €55 (usually €70). Usually: lunch €25–28; à la carte about €50–65.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨晚餐5道 €55（平时 €70）。平时：午餐 €25–28；单点人均约 €50–65。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Booking advised; book online.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。建议预订，可在网上订位。

items.name: Le Coq & Fils
items.subtitle: Poultry rotisserie
items.why: Antoine Westermann's Montmartre poultry house. Heritage French birds are poached, then spit-roasted and served whole to share, after a spread of starters for the table.
items.whyZh: Antoine Westermann 在蒙马特开的禽肉餐厅。选用法国传统品种的禽类，先煮后在烤架上转烤，整只上桌分享；开场先上一桌分享前菜。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Drôme guinea fowl with 5 sides and a bottle of wine, €62.50. Usually: à la carte about €65–95 a head; lunch dish of the day about €18 (2025 prices).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：德龙省珍珠鸡配5种配菜和一瓶葡萄酒 €62.50。平时：单点人均约 €65–95；午餐每日特餐约 €18（2025 年价格）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。

items.name: El Mictlan
items.subtitle: Mexican-French fusion
items.why: A Mexican-French restaurant and cocktail bar in the Sentier, decorated in a Day of the Dead spirit. Dishes to share such as duck confit tacos, sea bream ceviche and grilled fish of the day, with tequila and mezcal at the bar.
items.whyZh: Sentier 区的墨西哥法国融合餐厅兼鸡尾酒吧，装饰带亡灵节风格。适合分享的菜有油封鸭塔可、鲷鱼柠汁腌鱼（ceviche）和炭烤当日鲜鱼，吧台主打龙舌兰和梅斯卡尔。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's dinner, 5 courses, all included, €64 (usually €80); chef's dinner, 7 courses, all included, €76 (usually €95); ‘maize discovery’ lunch or dinner, 4 courses, all included, €52 (usually €65). Usually: plates about €18–32, small bites €6–16; chef's menus €65–95.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨晚餐5道，全包 €64（平时 €80）；主厨晚餐7道，全包 €76（平时 €95）；“玉米探索”午餐或晚餐4道，全包 €52（平时 €65）。平时：菜品约 €18–32，小食 €6–16；主厨套餐 €65–95。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Florina
items.subtitle: Modern French bistro
items.why: A bright little dining room facing the Val-de-Grâce, with an open kitchen. A short menu of modern takes on French classics, such as duck breast, guinea fowl or the fish of the day.
items.whyZh: 面对 Val-de-Grâce 的明亮小餐厅，厨房是开放式的。菜单简短，做现代风格的法国经典菜，比如鸭胸、珍珠鸡或当日鲜鱼。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Dinner, 4 courses, €59 (usually €70). Usually: 4-course dinner menu usually €70; à la carte about €31–45 a head.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：晚餐4道 €59（平时 €70）。平时：四道式晚餐套餐平时 €70；单点人均约 €31–45。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Indonesia
items.subtitle: Indonesian
items.why: A fixture near the Luxembourg Gardens since 1982, founded as a cooperative by Indonesian political refugees. Home-style Indonesian dishes such as chicken satay, with vegetarian, vegan and halal options.
items.whyZh: 卢森堡公园附近的老店，1982 年由印尼政治难民以合作社形式创办。供应家常印尼菜，比如沙爹鸡肉串，也有素食、纯素和清真选择。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Indonesian rice table with dessert, €38 (usually €45). Usually: lunch menu €20.50; starters about €10, mains about €19.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：印尼饭桌（rijsttafel）加甜点 €38（平时 €45）。平时：午餐套餐 €20.50；前菜约 €10，主菜约 €19。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。

items.name: Le Layon
items.subtitle: Modern French bistro
items.why: A neighbourhood bistro near Pernety, open for dinner only. The menu changes about every six weeks, with inventive plates such as salmon gravlax with beetroot, or aubergine with peanuts and mafé sauce.
items.whyZh: Pernety 地铁站附近的街区小酒馆，只做晚餐。菜单大约每六周换一次，菜式有新意，比如甜菜根配腌三文鱼，或花生烤茄子配西非花生酱（mafé）。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's dinner, 4 courses with a signature cocktail, €45. Usually: dinner menus about €45–49 (2025 prices).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨晚餐4道，配招牌鸡尾酒 €45。平时：晚餐套餐约 €45–49（2025 年价格）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Booking advised: online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。建议预订，可在网上或电话订位。

items.name: Magma
items.subtitle: Creative French
items.why: A contemporary bistro near Oberkampf where Japanese chef Ryuya Ono cooks creative, seasonal French menus that change daily. Sommelier Sasha Le Gal looks after the room and the wine.
items.whyZh: Oberkampf 附近的现代小酒馆，日本主厨 Ryuya Ono 做创意法式时令菜，菜单每天更换。侍酒师 Sasha Le Gal 负责餐厅和酒水。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's menu, 9 courses, €99 (usually €120); lunch, 6 courses with 3 glasses of wine, €80. Usually: weekday lunch €33; menus €70 (five courses) and €110 (seven).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨菜单9道 €99（平时 €120）；午餐6道，配3杯葡萄酒 €80。平时：工作日午餐 €33；套餐 €70（五道）和 €110（七道）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Booking advised; the five- and seven-course menus are by reservation.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。建议预订；五道和七道套餐需预约。

items.name: Maison Prunier
items.subtitle: Seafood and caviar
items.why: The historic caviar house behind a listed Art Deco mosaic façade, relaunched in autumn 2025 with a menu by chef Romain Fornell. Caviar, oysters, grilled fish and seafood classics in the restaurant, and a bar for oysters, caviar and cocktails.
items.whyZh: 历史悠久的鱼子酱名店，装饰艺术风格的马赛克外立面已列入保护建筑。2025 年秋天重新开张，菜单由主厨 Romain Fornell 设计：餐厅有鱼子酱、生蚝、烤鱼和经典海鲜菜，酒吧可以配生蚝和鱼子酱喝鸡尾酒。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Prunier menu, 3 courses, €110 (usually €130). Usually: lunch menu €48; à la carte about €90–250 (2025 prices).
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：Prunier 菜单3道 €110（平时 €130）。平时：午餐套餐 €48；单点人均约 €90–250（2025 年价格）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online (SevenRooms) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可通过 SevenRooms 在线预订或电话预订。

items.name: Mashita
items.subtitle: Contemporary Korean
items.why: The second, more polished branch of Ma-Shi-Ta, new in 2026 near the Marché Saint-Germain. Sookhyun Kim cooks Korean family recipes with carefully sourced meat and vegetables, with French wines and Korean sool to match.
items.whyZh: Ma-Shi-Ta 的第二家店，2026 年在圣日耳曼市场附近开业，比本店更精致。主厨 Sookhyun Kim 用精心挑选的肉和蔬菜做韩国家常菜，配法国葡萄酒和韩国传统酒。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: 3 courses with 2 glasses of Korean wine, €57 (usually €68); 2 courses with a cocktail or 2 Korean beers, €43 (usually €51); lunch, 3 courses with Korean tea, €31 (usually €39.50). Usually: lunch menu €39.50 with Korean tea; dinner menus €51–68 with drinks.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：3道，配2杯韩国酒 €57（平时 €68）；2道，配一杯鸡尾酒或2瓶韩国啤酒 €43（平时 €51）；午餐3道，配韩国茶 €31（平时 €39.50）。平时：午餐套餐 €39.50（含韩国茶）；晚餐套餐 €51–68（含酒水）。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online via the website or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可通过官网在线预订或电话预订。

items.name: Les Poulettes Batignolles
items.subtitle: French-Catalan bistro
items.subtitleZh: 法式加泰罗尼亚小酒馆
items.why: A Batignolles neo-bistro run by Ludovic Dubois and Judith Cercós. The slate follows the morning market and has a Catalan accent, with dishes such as roast salt cod with chorizo, clams and smoked aubergine.
items.whyZh: 巴蒂尼奥勒区的新派小酒馆，由 Ludovic Dubois 和 Judith Cercós 经营。黑板菜单跟着早市走，带加泰罗尼亚风味，比如烤盐渍鳕鱼配西班牙辣肠、蛤蜊和烟熏茄子。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's lunch or dinner, 3 courses with house white sangria, €80. Usually: à la carte about €70–75 a head.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨午餐或晚餐3道，配自制白桑格利亚 €80。平时：单点人均约 €70–75。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book online on the website or by phone.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。可在官网在线预订或电话预订。

items.name: Saku Vendôme
items.subtitle: Sushi and omakase
items.why: Near Place Vendôme, on the site of the old Kinugawa, which the family behind Tsukizi took over in 2025. Sushi, sashimi, tempura and robata dishes à la carte, or an omakase at an eight-seat counter.
items.whyZh: 位于旺多姆广场附近，原址是老牌日料店 Kinugawa，2025 年由 Tsukizi 背后的家族接手。可以单点寿司、刺身、天妇罗和炉端烧，也可以坐八人吧台吃无菜单料理。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's lunch or dinner, 4 courses with extras, €85 (usually €100). Usually: omakase €145; lunch bento €42; à la carte about €100 a head.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨午餐或晚餐4道，另有加菜 €85（平时 €100）。平时：无菜单料理 €145；午餐便当 €42；单点人均约 €100。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Book the omakase ahead: eight seats per sitting (12:00, 19:00, 21:00).
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。无菜单料理每轮只有八个座位（12:00、19:00、21:00），请提前预订。

items.name: Seoul Lab
items.subtitle: Modern Korean
items.why: Chef Juwon Kim, from Pohang and trained at Le Cordon Bleu, gives Korean classics his own twist: mandu, fried chicken, bulgogi and his signature jeyuk pork. Quick, flavourful and fairly priced.
items.whyZh: 来自浦项、在蓝带厨艺学院受训的主厨 Juwon Kim 用自己的方式演绎韩国经典菜：饺子、炸鸡、烤牛肉和招牌辣炒猪肉。上菜快，味道足，价格公道。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: À la carte, with Korean wine. Usually: lunch menu €18.50–21.50; mains €10–23 (2024 prices).
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr.
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。

items.name: Shin Izakaya
items.subtitle: Japanese izakaya
items.why: A lively izakaya in Saint-Germain from the same group as Saku and Tsukizi. Small plates to share, based on family recipes: karaage chicken, mackerel simmered in miso and miso-glazed aubergine, with sake and cocktails.
items.whyZh: 圣日耳曼区一家热闹的居酒屋，与 Saku、Tsukizi 同属一个集团。小菜适合分享，源自家常菜谱：日式炸鸡、味噌煮鲭鱼、味噌烤茄子，配清酒和鸡尾酒。
items.price: Paris Restaurant Week, until 15 Nov 2026: Chef's lunch or dinner, 3 courses with roasted green tea, €38 (usually €45). Usually: plates €4–30; weekday lunch bento €23; group omakase €39–49 a head.
items.priceZh: 巴黎餐厅周（至2026年11月15日）：主厨午餐或晚餐3道，配焙茶 €38（平时 €45）。平时：小菜 €4–30；工作日午餐便当 €23；多人无菜单套餐每人 €39–49。
items.note: Book the Restaurant Week menu on restaurantweek.fr. Booking advised, especially at weekends (OpenTable or phone).
items.noteZh: 餐厅周套餐请在 restaurantweek.fr 上预订。建议预订，周末尤其如此（OpenTable 或电话）。

items.name: Abstinence
items.subtitle: French sharing plates
items.why: Seasonal bistro plates to share under a leafy glass roof near the Champ de Mars, from the team behind Fitzgerald. It stays open late as a wine bar and has a sunny terrace.
items.whyZh: 战神广场附近的小酒馆，在满是绿植的玻璃顶下吃时令分享菜，由 Fitzgerald 团队经营。晚上营业到很晚，兼作酒吧，还有向阳露台。
items.price: About €30–50 a head; plates €9–28
items.note: Book online (SevenRooms) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可通过 SevenRooms 在线或电话预订。

items.name: Au Passage
items.subtitle: Small-plates bistro
items.why: A long-running wine bar and bistro tucked down a passage in the 11th. Seasonal small plates from the market, with a wide choice of natural wines.
items.whyZh: 藏在 11 区小巷里的老牌葡萄酒吧兼小酒馆。用市场时令食材做小盘菜，自然酒选择很多。
items.price: Small plates to share
items.priceZh: 小盘菜，适合分享
items.note: Dinner only. Book online; bookings open one month ahead.
items.noteZh: 只做晚餐。可在网上预订，提前一个月开放订位。

items.name: Ayahuma
items.subtitle: Ecuadorian bistro
items.why: A friendly Ecuadorian bistro near Charonne, a rare find in Paris. Andean-born chef Javier Armijos gives family dishes such as mote pillo and plantain corviche a modern touch, and lunch is good value.
items.whyZh: Charonne 附近一家亲切的厄瓜多尔小馆，在巴黎很少见。来自安第斯山区的主厨 Javier Armijos 用现代手法做家乡菜，比如 mote pillo 和大蕉做的 corviche；午餐很划算。
items.price: Starters about €14, mains €22–29, desserts €10; lunch menus under €20 (2023 prices)
items.priceZh: 前菜约 €14，主菜 €22–29，甜点 €10；午市套餐不到 €20（2023 年价格）
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Babi
items.subtitle: Neo-bistro and wine bar
items.subtitleZh: 新派小酒馆兼葡萄酒吧
items.why: A small Sentier wine bar with a kitchen counter, run by two alumni of Shabour and Tékés. A short menu of inventive sharing plates, such as lobster tortellini with pastis, and over 350 wines.
items.whyZh: Sentier 区的小酒馆兼葡萄酒吧，设有面向厨房的吧台，两位主理人曾在 Shabour 和 Tékés 工作。菜单简短，都是有创意的分享菜，比如茴香酒龙虾意式饺子，酒单超过 350 款。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六 19:00–00:00；周五、周六另有午餐
items.price: Sharing plates €9–34; lunch (Fri–Sat) €36–42
items.priceZh: 分享菜 €9–34；周五、周六午餐 €36–42
items.note: Book on Zenchef; about ten counter seats are kept for walk-ins.
items.noteZh: 可通过 Zenchef 预订；约十个吧台座位留给现场来客。

items.name: Benihana
items.subtitle: Teppanyaki show cooking
items.why: Teppanyaki by the Palais-Royal: chefs cook meat, seafood and vegetables on a hot plate in front of you, with a bit of a show. There is also a sushi bar. Good for groups.
items.whyZh: 皇家宫殿旁的铁板烧，厨师在你面前的铁板上做肉、海鲜和蔬菜，带点表演。另有寿司吧，适合多人聚餐。
items.price: Teppanyaki set menus €25–160 (vegetable to wagyu)
items.priceZh: 铁板烧套餐 €25–160（从蔬菜到和牛）
items.note: Book online through the restaurant's website.
items.noteZh: 可通过餐厅官网在线预订。

items.name: Bistrot Ordinaire
items.subtitle: Chinese bistro
items.why: A Chinese bistro on Rue Keller near Bastille, at the old Café Moderne address, with vegetarian options. No reviews or menu online yet: check before you go.
items.whyZh: Bastille 附近 Rue Keller 上的中式小馆，原址是 Café Moderne，有素食选择。网上暂时找不到评价或菜单，去之前最好先确认。
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Bokko
items.subtitle: Korean canteen
items.why: A no-frills Korean canteen on Place du Commerce, with K-pop on the screens, popular with Koreans in Paris. The fried chicken is the highlight; there are also stews, spicy bulgogi and kimchi pancakes.
items.whyZh: Commerce 广场上朴实的韩式食堂，屏幕上放着 K-pop，很受在巴黎的韩国人欢迎。炸鸡是招牌，也有汤锅、辣味烤肉和泡菜饼。
items.price: Mains €16–20; lunch set €18 (2023 prices)

items.name: Casa Pregonda
items.subtitle: Spanish, Menorcan-inspired
items.why: A Menorca-inspired Spanish house in Sentier, all green shutters and tiled floors. Seafood leads: carabinero prawns, clams, squid-ink rice and Menorcan lobster stew, then Iberian pork or Galician beef.
items.whyZh: Sentier 区一家以梅诺卡岛为灵感的西班牙餐厅，绿色百叶窗配花砖地面。海鲜是主角：红魔虾、蛤蜊、墨鱼汁饭和梅诺卡龙虾锅，也有伊比利亚猪肉和加利西亚牛肉。
items.price: À la carte about €35–88 a head
items.priceZh: 单点人均约 €35–88
items.note: Dinner only. Book on Zenchef or call +33 1 40 13 00 22.
items.noteZh: 只供应晚餐。可通过 Zenchef 或致电 +33 1 40 13 00 22 预订。

items.name: Casa San Pablo
items.subtitle: Spanish tapas
items.why: A warm Spanish bar a few steps from Saint-Paul métro. Tapas to share, such as ham croquetas, with sangria or a cocktail; it opens late afternoon on weekdays.
items.whyZh: 离 Saint-Paul 地铁站几步路的西班牙小酒馆，气氛热络。适合分享 tapas，比如火腿可乐饼，配桑格利亚或鸡尾酒；工作日傍晚才开门。
items.price: Tapas to share at mid-range prices
items.priceZh: 分享式 tapas，价格中等

items.name: Chantira
items.subtitle: Modern Thai
items.why: Modern Thai cooking near rue Mouffetard: kaphrao, pomelo salad and satay rather than pad thai. Natural French wines and Thai coffee to go with it.
items.whyZh: 穆浮塔街附近的现代泰国菜馆，做打抛、柚子沙拉和沙爹，而不是泰式炒河粉。搭配法国自然酒和泰式咖啡。
items.price: Lunch menu €19–23; small plates €7–10, mains €16–18

items.name: Chez Rosito
items.subtitle: Corsican home cooking
items.why: A small, homely Corsican bistro just off the Place des Vosges, open since 1997. Hearty island cooking: wild boar stew with polenta, cannelloni with brocciu cheese, chestnut-flour cake.
items.whyZh: 孚日广场旁的科西嘉小馆，1997 年开业，朴实温馨。菜式扎实：野猪肉炖配玉米糊、brocciu 奶酪焗面卷、栗子粉蛋糕。
items.address: 4 Rue du Pas de la Mule, 75003 Paris
items.price: Three-course menu €35.50, two courses €31.50; lunch menu €20 (older prices)
items.priceZh: 三道式套餐 €35.50，两道式 €31.50；午餐套餐 €20（价格较旧）
items.note: Booking advised.
items.noteZh: 建议预订。

items.name: Delhi Bazaar
items.subtitle: Modern Indian
items.why: A busy Indian restaurant in the 11th with plates to share: chaat, paneer tikka, korma and a biryani baked under a naan crust. Finish with the cardamom soft-serve sundae.
items.whyZh: 第十一区人气很旺的印度餐厅，菜品适合分享：chaat 街头小吃、paneer tikka 烤奶酪、korma 咖喱，还有盖着馕皮焗的 biryani。最后来一份小豆蔻软冰淇淋圣代。
items.price: About €20–35 a head
items.note: Popular: book ahead.
items.noteZh: 人气旺，建议提前预订。

items.name: Dents de Loup
items.subtitle: Butcher’s lunch counter
items.why: A butcher’s shop from the Viande Viande team that buys whole carcasses and serves lunch at the counter: sausage and mash, terrines and a dish of the day, with natural wines.
items.whyZh: Viande Viande 团队开的肉铺，整只采购、自行分割，中午在吧台供餐：香肠配土豆泥、肉冻派和每日菜，配自然酒。
items.price: Lunch dish about €19; charcuterie plates €9–22
items.priceZh: 午餐主菜约 €19；熟食拼盘 €9–22

items.name: Derrière
items.subtitle: Home-style French
items.why: Hidden behind a courtyard and set out like a flat, with tables in rooms such as a living room and a bedroom. Seasonal French cooking and a Sunday brunch buffet.
items.whyZh: 藏在庭院后面，布置得像一套公寓，可以在客厅或卧室里用餐。供应时令法式菜，周日有自助早午餐。
items.price: Weekday lunch €25–32; Sunday brunch €39; à la carte mains €26–43
items.priceZh: 工作日午市 €25–32；周日早午餐 €39；单点主菜 €26–43

items.name: DokiDoki Marbeuf
items.subtitle: Hand roll bar
items.why: Temaki hand rolls made to order, with warm rice and crisp nori, a short walk from the Champs-Élysées. Quick and casual, with matcha and Japanese-style ice cream to finish.
items.whyZh: 离香榭丽舍大街几步路的手卷寿司吧，现点现卷，米饭温热、海苔酥脆。吃得快又随意，饭后可来杯抹茶或日式口味冰淇淋。
items.price: About €30 a head
items.priceZh: 人均约 €30

items.name: Dong Né
items.subtitle: Korean street food
items.why: A small Korean street-food spot in the 15th: gimbap in several versions, fried chicken and cheesy tteokbokki. Cheap set menus, counter seats and a terrace.
items.whyZh: 十五区的韩式街头小吃店：多种紫菜包饭、韩式炸鸡和芝士辣炒年糕。套餐便宜，有吧台座和露台。
items.price: Set menus from about €15
items.priceZh: 套餐约 €15 起

items.name: Duvin
items.subtitle: Wine bistro
items.why: A wine-first bistro at the bottom of rue Pigalle, with a huge French list picked by owner Pierre Guignard. Bistro classics to match, such as oeufs mayo and tête de veau.
items.whyZh: Pigalle 街口一家以酒为主角的小酒馆，老板 Pierre Guignard 精选的法国酒单极其丰富，配酒的是蛋黄酱鸡蛋、小牛头肉等经典小馆菜。
items.price: Lunch menus €24–29; à la carte about €75 (2025 prices)
items.priceZh: 午市套餐 €24–29；单点人均约 €75（2025 年价格）
items.note: Book ahead; it fills up.
items.noteZh: 建议提前预订，常常客满。

items.name: Elbi
items.subtitle: Egyptian bistro
items.why: A bistro and wine bar from starred chef Omar Dhiab, mixing Egyptian and Tunisian flavours with French bistro cooking. Try the hawawshi, the glazed aubergine and the kunefe rice pudding.
items.whyZh: 米其林星级主厨 Omar Dhiab 开的小酒馆兼葡萄酒吧，把埃及和突尼斯风味融入法式小馆菜。推荐 hawawshi 肉馅饼、石榴酱汁茄子和 kunefe 米布丁。
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Epoca
items.subtitle: Italian bistro
items.why: Chef Denny Imbroisi's Italian bistro near Le Bon Marché, in a room styled on 1930s Paris. Pasta, slow-cooked dishes and Italian classics such as tiramisu.
items.whyZh: 主厨 Denny Imbroisi 的意式小酒馆，靠近 Le Bon Marché 百货，装潢仿 1930 年代巴黎。供应意面、慢炖菜和提拉米苏等意式经典。
items.price: Starters €13–18, pasta €21–40, mains €23–28, desserts €12–14
items.note: Book online via the website.
items.noteZh: 可通过官网在线预订。

items.name: Gangnam Grill
items.subtitle: Korean barbecue
items.why: A Korean barbecue restaurant in Courbevoie, just outside Paris to the north-west.
items.whyZh: 位于巴黎西北近郊 Courbevoie 的韩式烤肉店。
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Gemüse
items.subtitle: Berlin-style kebab
items.why: Berlin-style kebabs filled with grilled vegetables and feta, plus chicken and vegetarian versions. A small, cheap spot near Jules Joffrin metro with about ten seats.
items.whyZh: 柏林风格的烤肉卷，夹烤蔬菜和菲达奶酪，也有鸡肉和素食版本。小店在 Jules Joffrin 地铁站附近，只有十来个座位，价格便宜。
items.price: Kebabs about €6–8; meal deals €8–14 (2018 prices)
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Gosier
items.subtitle: Seasonal sharing plates
items.why: A friendly evening spot near Anvers for seasonal plates to share, all made in-house and changed every two weeks, with a well-chosen wine list. Brunch on Sundays.
items.whyZh: Anvers 附近氛围亲切的晚间小馆，时令分享小盘全部自制、每两周换菜单，酒单精选。周日供应早午餐。
items.price: Starters €11–18, mains €15–21

items.name: Grill 92
items.subtitle: Korean BBQ buffet
items.why: All-you-can-eat Korean barbecue in Clichy, just outside Paris. Grilled meats and seafood, plus bibimbap, japchae and tteokbokki. Good for groups.
items.whyZh: 巴黎近郊 Clichy 的韩式烤肉自助，烤肉和海鲜之外还有拌饭、杂菜和炒年糕，适合聚餐。
items.price: All-you-can-eat about €31
items.priceZh: 自助畅吃约 €31
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: GYŪ+
items.subtitle: All-you-can-eat yakiniku
items.why: Japanese yakiniku in the 13th’s Asian quarter: grill your own meat at the table, all you can eat for two hours, with sushi rolls and small Japanese plates on the menu. Drinks and desserts are extra.
items.whyZh: 13 区亚洲街区的日式烤肉自助：桌边自己烤肉，限时两小时，菜单上还有寿司卷和日式小菜。饮料和甜点另外收费。
items.price: All you can eat €24.90 (weekday lunch) to €33.90; with an A5 wagyu platter €51.90–54.90
items.note: Book online on the website; meals are limited to two hours.
items.noteZh: 可在官网在线订位；用餐限时两小时。

items.name: Haikara
items.subtitle: Japanese fried food
items.why: Japanese fried food at a counter on Boulevard Voltaire: tonkatsu, karaage and tempura, on their own or on rice as a donburi. Quick, casual and cheap.
items.whyZh: 伏尔泰大道上的日式炸物吧台：炸猪排、日式炸鸡和天妇罗，可单点，也可做成盖饭。快捷随意，价格不贵。
items.price: Fried dishes €10–16 (€3 more as a donburi); sides €3–10

items.name: Hando
items.subtitle: Japanese hand rolls
items.why: Temaki hand rolls made to order at a counter bar, with Japanese nori and fish from small French boats. Quick, casual and fairly priced.
items.whyZh: 吧台现点现做的日式手卷，用日本海苔和法国小船捕捞的鱼。吃得快，氛围随意，价格实在。
items.price: Sets of 3–6 hand rolls €19–42; single rolls from €6 (2025 menu)
items.priceZh: 3–6 个手卷的套餐 €19–42；单个手卷 €6 起（2025 年菜单）
items.note: Book online on the website; takeaway and delivery too.
items.noteZh: 可在官网预订；也有外卖和自取。

items.name: Hangari 항아리
items.subtitle: Korean home cooking
items.why: A Korean restaurant near the Bourse with a cosy upstairs room. Go for bibimbap, Korean barbecue or samgyetang, the ginseng chicken soup.
items.whyZh: 交易所附近的韩国餐厅，楼上用餐区小而温馨。可以点拌饭、韩式烤肉或参鸡汤。
items.price: About €20–30 a head
items.note: Booking advised: online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 建议预订，可在网上或电话订位。

items.name: Iodé Sushi
items.subtitle: Sushi and omakase
items.why: A small sushi counter near the Eiffel Tower, using local, seasonal seafood. Sushi, chirashi or sashimi sets at lunch; an omakase menu at dinner.
items.whyZh: 埃菲尔铁塔附近的小寿司吧台，用本地当季海鲜。午餐有寿司、散寿司或刺身套餐，晚餐是无菜单料理。
items.price: Lunch €32–38; dinner omakase €92 (2024 prices)
items.priceZh: 午餐 €32–38；晚餐无菜单料理 €92（2024 年价格）
items.note: Book online on the restaurant's website.
items.noteZh: 可在餐厅官网在线预订。

items.name: Jaja
items.subtitle: Seasonal French bistro
items.why: A calm courtyard restaurant hidden behind a Marais doorway, with a glass-roofed room and a leafy terrace. Short seasonal menu and a good choice of wines by the glass.
items.whyZh: 藏在玛黑区一道门廊后的庭院餐厅，有玻璃顶餐室和绿意盎然的露台。菜单简短、随季节变化，单杯酒选择不错。
items.address: 3 Rue Sainte-Croix de la Bretonnerie, 75004 Paris
items.price: Lunch menus €22 (two courses) and €26 (three courses)
items.priceZh: 午市套餐 €22（两道）和 €26（三道）

items.name: Jinchan Shokudo
items.subtitle: Japanese canteen
items.why: A busy Japanese canteen near Faidherbe-Chaligny for karaage, donburi, sashimi and small plates, with plenty of sake by the glass. The first Japanese restaurant in France with the Ecotable eco-label.
items.whyZh: Faidherbe-Chaligny 地铁站附近人气很旺的日式食堂，有日式炸鸡、盖饭、刺身和各种小菜，杯卖清酒选择多。也是法国第一家获得 Ecotable 环保认证的日本餐厅。
items.price: Donburi €13–14; small plates €2–12 (2023 prices)
items.note: Arrive at 12:00 to beat the office lunch queue.
items.noteZh: 午餐建议 12:00 准时到，避开上班族排队。

items.name: Joayo Saint-Sulpice
items.subtitle: Korean barbecue
items.why: Korean barbecue near Saint-Sulpice: you grill the meat at your table, with a house sauce, rice and four side dishes. Add some Korean fried chicken.
items.whyZh: 圣叙尔皮斯附近的韩式烤肉店，在桌上自己烤肉，配自制酱汁、米饭和四样小菜。也可以加点韩式炸鸡。
items.price: About €30–40 a head
items.note: Book ahead for dinner.
items.noteZh: 晚餐建议提前预订。

items.name: Kakdougui
items.subtitle: Korean barbecue
items.why: A Korean restaurant in the 14th where you grill beef and pork ribs at the table. Stews such as budae jjigae are on the menu too.
items.whyZh: 十四区的韩国餐厅，牛肉和猪排骨在桌上自己烤，也有部队锅等炖菜。
items.price: About €20–30 a head

items.name: Kamakiri
items.subtitle: Hakata udon
items.why: Hakata-style udon on Little Tokyo's Rue de Port-Mahon: chewy noodles in broth with tempura, served fast in a semi-self-service room. There is a vegan udon too.
items.whyZh: 小东京 Port-Mahon 街上的博多风格乌冬面店：汤乌冬面条筋道，配天妇罗，半自助，出餐快，也有纯素乌冬。
items.price: Udon from about €17; lunch set about €20
items.priceZh: 乌冬面约 €17 起；午餐套餐约 €20

items.name: Kawamoto
items.subtitle: Japanese omakase
items.why: A small Japanese restaurant near Bastille with about 16 seats, popular with Japanese diners. The chef worked in Kyoto fine dining; the evening omakase brings sushi, sashimi and tempura.
items.whyZh: 巴士底附近的小日本餐厅，只有约 16 个座位，很受在巴黎的日本人欢迎。主厨曾在京都的高级餐厅工作，晚餐无菜单料理有寿司、刺身和天妇罗。
items.price: Weekday lunch €20; evening omakase €54 (2022 prices)
items.priceZh: 工作日午餐 €20；晚餐无菜单料理 €54（2022 年价格）
items.note: Only about 16 seats: book ahead.
items.noteZh: 只有约 16 个座位，建议提前预订。

items.name: Kiwamiya Ramen
items.subtitle: Ramen shop
items.why: A Tokyo-style ramen shop in Boulogne with house-made noodles and chicken, pork or vegetarian broths. Try the spicy tori paitan miso, with gyoza on the side.
items.whyZh: 布洛涅的东京风拉面店，面条自制，汤底有鸡汤、猪骨汤和素汤。推荐辣味鸡白汤味噌拉面，配一份煎饺。
items.price: Ramen €12–18; starters €4–7 (2022 prices)
items.note: No bookings: expect a queue; pairs get counter seats faster.
items.noteZh: 不接受预订，常需排队；两人可坐吧台，入座更快。

items.name: Komatsubaki
items.subtitle: Kaiseki and omakase
items.why: Seasonal kaiseki in the 8th from Ryuma Takubo, who trained in Fukuoka. Sit at the counter to watch him work, or take the tatami room; there is also a vegetarian shojin menu.
items.whyZh: 在福冈学艺的 Ryuma Takubo 在第八区做时令怀石料理。可坐吧台看他料理，也可选榻榻米包间；另有素食精进料理套餐。
items.price: Dinner menus (omakase, sushi kaiseki, vegetarian shojin kaiseki) about €130
items.priceZh: 晚餐套餐（无菜单、寿司怀石、素食精进怀石）约 €130
items.note: Counter seats are in demand: book early.
items.noteZh: 吧台座位抢手，请尽早预订。

items.name: L'Atlantide
items.subtitle: North African (Berber)
items.why: A long-standing Berber restaurant near the Buttes-Chaumont park. Couscous, tagines such as lamb with figs and dates, chicken pastilla and méchoui, in a traditional, homely room.
items.whyZh: Buttes-Chaumont 公园附近的老牌柏柏尔餐厅。有古斯古斯、无花果椰枣羊肉塔吉锅、鸡肉帕斯蒂拉馅饼和烤全羊，环境传统温馨。
items.price: About €22–37 a head (2020 prices)
items.note: Book for weekend evenings.
items.noteZh: 周末晚上建议预订。

items.name: l'Oisillon 雛
items.subtitle: Chinese cooking
items.why: A newish Chinese restaurant on Rue Basfroi; 雛, like its French name, means a young bird. No reviews or menu online yet: check its Instagram before you go.
items.whyZh: Rue Basfroi 上一家较新的中餐馆，店名“雛”和法文名一样，意为雏鸟。网上暂时找不到评价或菜单，去之前可以先看看它的 Instagram。
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: L'Îlot
items.subtitle: Oyster and seafood bar
items.why: A tiny seafood bar in the upper Marais: oysters, whelks, prawns, crab and house taramasalata, with natural wines. Casual and good value.
items.whyZh: 上玛黑区的迷你海鲜吧：生蚝、海螺、虾、螃蟹和自制鳕鱼子酱，配自然酒，随意又实惠。
items.price: Oysters about €20 a dozen; small seafood plates
items.priceZh: 生蚝一打约 €20；另有海鲜小盘
items.note: Small room: book or arrive early.
items.noteZh: 店面很小：建议预订或早点到。

items.name: La Bonne Mer
items.subtitle: Seafood bistro
items.why: A tiny seafood restaurant on the Butte-aux-Cailles with a Mediterranean touch: grilled octopus, sea bream carpaccio and fish from the plancha.
items.whyZh: 鹌鹑山丘（Butte-aux-Cailles）上的小海鲜馆，带地中海风味：烤章鱼、鲷鱼薄片和铁板煎鱼。
items.address: 22 Rue du Moulin des Prés, 75013 Paris
items.note: Small and often full: book ahead.
items.noteZh: 店小常满座，建议提前预订。

items.name: La Plume Rive Droite
items.subtitle: French-Japanese
items.why: A leafy, smart restaurant in the Madame Rêve hotel, looking over Saint-Eustache and the rooftops. Chef Benjamin Six cooks French food with Japanese touches, such as gyoza, wagyu tataki and teriyaki salmon.
items.whyZh: 位于 Madame Rêve 酒店内，绿植环绕、装修考究，可眺望圣厄斯塔什教堂和巴黎屋顶。主厨 Benjamin Six 做带日式元素的法餐，比如煎饺、和牛 tataki 和照烧三文鱼。
items.price: Lunch menu €45 (2 courses) or €55 (3); à la carte mains €34–58; sharing menu €125
items.note: Book online (SevenRooms) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可通过 SevenRooms 在线或电话预订。

items.name: Lacigne
items.subtitle: Japanese bistro
items.why: A tiny Japanese bistro run by a couple: Daisuke Kikuchi, who trained at L'Atelier Robuchon, cooks donburi and curry, and Mégumi Kikuchi makes the desserts and mochi. The set lunch is very good value.
items.whyZh: 夫妻俩开的小小日式小馆：Daisuke Kikuchi 曾在 L'Atelier Robuchon 工作，做盖饭和咖喱；Mégumi Kikuchi 做甜点和麻糬。午市套餐很划算。
items.price: Lunch menus €20–22; à la carte about €30–50

items.name: Le Bœuf Volant
items.subtitle: Steakhouse
items.why: A steakhouse near Place de Clichy serving US Black Angus cuts with hand-cut chips. Australian and Japanese wagyu is sold by weight, at a price.
items.whyZh: 克利希广场附近的牛排馆，主打美国黑安格斯牛排配手切薯条。澳洲和日本和牛按重量计价，价格不低。
items.price: Menu €58 (starter, steak, side, dessert); prime beef and wagyu by weight, €240–650/kg (2025 menu)
items.priceZh: 套餐 €58（前菜、牛排、配菜、甜点）；顶级牛肉和和牛按重量计价，每公斤 €240–650（2025 年菜单）
items.note: Book online.
items.noteZh: 可在网上预订。

items.name: Le Clos Y
items.subtitle: French-Japanese tasting menus
items.why: Japanese chef Yoshitaka Ikeda cooks French food with Japanese restraint, served as tasting menus near Montparnasse. Lunch is the cheaper way to try it.
items.whyZh: 日本主厨 Yoshitaka Ikeda 以日式的克制做法餐，在蒙帕纳斯附近只供应品尝套餐。午餐更实惠。
items.price: Lunch tasting menu €45 (4 courses, Tue–Fri); dinner tasting menu €78 (7 courses)
items.priceZh: 午餐品尝套餐 €45（4 道，周二至周五）；晚餐品尝套餐 €78（7 道）
items.note: Book on the website or by phone; groups of six or more two weeks ahead.
items.noteZh: 可在官网或电话预订；六人以上需提前两周。

items.name: Le Crépuscule
items.subtitle: Crêperie
items.why: A small neighbourhood crêperie on a quiet street between the Invalides and the Eiffel Tower. Buckwheat galettes such as goat's cheese, sausage and mushroom, sweet crêpes like chestnut cream, and cider.
items.whyZh: 荣军院和埃菲尔铁塔之间一条安静小街上的街坊可丽饼店。荞麦咸饼（如山羊奶酪香肠蘑菇）、栗子奶油甜可丽饼，再配一杯苹果酒。
items.price: No published prices; reviewers call it good value
items.priceZh: 未查到价目；食客普遍认为价格实惠

items.name: Le Mandarin de Choisy
items.subtitle: Chinese and pan-Asian
items.why: A Chinatown restaurant on the corner of Avenue de Choisy and Rue de Tolbiac. Dim sum, Peking duck and wok dishes, plus Thai and Vietnamese standards; easy and cheap for a group.
items.whyZh: 中国城里 Choisy 大道与 Tolbiac 街交角的餐馆。有点心、北京烤鸭和各式炒菜，也有泰式和越式常见菜，适合多人实惠聚餐。
items.price: Dim sum €5.50–8.50; most dishes €10–14; Peking duck from €35

items.name: Maison Revka
items.subtitle: Slavic and caviar
items.why: A theatrical Paris Society mansion between Victor Hugo and Trocadéro, all velvet and gilt, with a summer garden. The menu plays on Slavic classics: caviar, smoked salmon, coulibiac, pelmeni and medovik honey cake.
items.whyZh: Paris Society 旗下的豪宅餐厅，位于维克多·雨果广场和特罗卡德罗之间，丝绒金饰，夏天有花园。菜单演绎斯拉夫经典：鱼子酱、烟熏三文鱼、俄式鲑鱼派、pelmeni 饺子和蜂蜜蛋糕。
items.price: Starters €16–42; mains €36–62; caviar from €135 (30 g)
items.note: Book online (SevenRooms).
items.noteZh: 可在 SevenRooms 网上预订。

items.name: MASHIL
items.subtitle: Korean comfort food
items.why: A small, cosy Korean spot by Félix Faure metro station. Share a pan of spicy tteokbokki, or have tonkatsu or bibimbap, with hotteok or bingsu to finish.
items.whyZh: Félix Faure 地铁站旁的温馨小韩餐馆。可以点一锅辣炒年糕大家分享，也有炸猪排和拌饭，最后来份糖饼或刨冰。
items.price: About €18–25 a head; lunch menu €17
items.priceZh: 人均约 €18–25；午市套餐 €17

items.name: Melt
items.subtitle: Texas barbecue
items.why: A Texas-style smokehouse: brisket smoked for up to 15 hours, pulled pork, ribs and smoked chicken, served on metal trays.
items.whyZh: 德州风格烟熏烧烤：最长熏 15 小时的牛胸肉、手撕猪肉、猪肋排和烟熏鸡，用铁盘上桌。
items.address: 74 Rue de la Folie Méricourt, 75011 Paris
items.price: Meats about €10–17, sides about €4 (older prices)
items.priceZh: 肉类约 €10–17，配菜约 €4（价格可能已变）
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: MiYuk 미육
items.subtitle: Korean grill and stews
items.why: A Korean restaurant in the 8th serving grilled meats with rice, from pork belly to LA-style short ribs, plus hot-stone bibimbap and spicy stews. Some meats are halal.
items.whyZh: 第八区的韩国餐厅，烤肉配米饭，从五花肉到 LA 式牛小排都有，另有石锅拌饭和辣味炖汤，部分肉类为清真。
items.price: Bibimbap €17–18; stews €18–20; grilled meats €20–33

items.name: Mokoloco
items.subtitle: Traditional Mexican
items.why: The Mokonuts team's dinner spot, now cooking traditional Mexican food under chef José Oviedo. A four-course set menu with a few choices at each course.
items.whyZh: Mokonuts 团队的晚餐餐厅，现由主厨 José Oviedo 做传统墨西哥菜。四道式套餐，每道有几种选择。
items.price: Four-course set menu €50
items.priceZh: 四道式套餐 €50
items.note: Booking strongly advised, by phone or online; walk-ins welcome.
items.noteZh: 强烈建议电话或网上预订，也接待散客。

items.name: Mokonuts
items.subtitle: Levantine-tinged bistro
items.why: A tiny family-run lunch spot: Omar Koreitem cooks comforting dishes with Levantine touches, and Moko Hirayama makes the desserts and the well-known cookies.
items.whyZh: 一家很小的家庭式午餐馆：Omar Koreitem 做带黎凡特风味的家常菜，Moko Hirayama 负责甜点和出名的曲奇。
items.price: Starters €8–16, mains €24–32, desserts from €11
items.note: Weekday lunch only, and booking is required (online or by phone).
items.noteZh: 只在工作日供应午餐，必须预订（网上或电话）。

items.name: Morann 모란식당
items.subtitle: North Korean cooking
items.why: It bills itself as a specialist in North Korean food, which is rare in Paris. Order Pyongyang cold noodles or abai sundae sausage; South Korean dishes such as bibimbap are on the menu too.
items.whyZh: 自称专做朝鲜菜，这在巴黎很少见。推荐平壤冷面和朝鲜式米肠，也有拌饭等韩国菜。
items.price: About €20–30 a head

items.name: Muku
items.subtitle: Izakaya counter
items.why: A small izakaya in a stone-walled cellar off Saint-Michel, with close-set counter seats. Chef Ryota Suzuki serves good-value sashimi, chirashi and karaage sets at lunch, and plates such as miso black cod at night.
items.whyZh: 圣米歇尔附近一个石墙地窖里的小居酒屋，吧台座位挨得很近。主厨 Ryota Suzuki 午餐做划算的刺身、散寿司和日式炸鸡套餐，晚上有味噌银鳕鱼等小菜。
items.price: Lunch set €21; dinner à la carte, mains €17–29
items.priceZh: 午市套餐 €21；晚餐单点，主菜 €17–29

items.name: narro
items.subtitle: Neo-bistro
items.why: A neighbourhood bistro near the Contrescarpe where Japanese chef Kazuma Chikuda cooks creative, seasonal French plates. Natural wines and a big terrace.
items.whyZh: Contrescarpe 广场附近的街区小馆，日本主厨 Kazuma Chikuda 做有创意的时令法餐，有自然酒和宽敞的露台。
items.price: Weekday lunch €29–36; dinner about €55–70
items.priceZh: 工作日午市 €29–36；晚餐人均约 €55–70
items.note: Book ahead.
items.noteZh: 建议提前预订。

items.name: Onii-San
items.subtitle: Tokyo-style izakaya
items.why: A colourful Tokyo-style izakaya in the Marais. Share small plates such as yellowtail sushi, a tuna toro sando and flame-seared wagyu, with sake.
items.whyZh: 玛黑区一家色彩鲜艳的东京风居酒屋，适合几个人点小盘菜分享，比如鰤鱼寿司、金枪鱼腩三明治和炙烤和牛，再配点清酒。
items.price: About €30–50 a head
items.note: Book online on the restaurant's website.
items.noteZh: 可在餐厅官网在线预订。

items.name: OOBATZ
items.subtitle: Sourdough pizza
items.why: Dan Pearson's pizzeria in Ménilmontant: crisp, long-fermented sourdough pizzas baked in about 90 seconds. Time Out ranks it among the best pizzas in the world.
items.whyZh: Dan Pearson 在 Ménilmontant 开的披萨店，酸种面团长时间发酵，约 90 秒快速烤成，饼底酥脆。Time Out 把它列入全球最佳披萨榜。
items.price: Pizzas €16–26; desserts €6–14
items.note: Book online; dates open two weeks ahead, with a few seats kept for walk-ins.
items.noteZh: 可在网上预订，提前两周开放；也会留少量座位给现场客人。

items.name: Ora Farmhouse
items.subtitle: Seasonal flexitarian
items.why: A farmhouse-style restaurant in the old Pavillon du Lac, inside the Buttes-Chaumont park, with a big terrace under the trees. Seasonal, mostly vegetable-led plates for sharing, and brunch on Sundays.
items.whyZh: 位于肖蒙山丘公园内旧湖畔亭（Pavillon du Lac）的农舍风餐厅，树荫下有大露台。时令菜以蔬菜为主，适合分享；周日有早午餐。
items.price: Lunch menu €24 for two courses, €32 for three; à la carte about €30–50; Sunday brunch €36 (2024–25 prices)
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐两道 €24、三道 €32；单点人均约 €30–50；周日早午餐 €36（2024–25 年价格）
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Orgueil
items.subtitle: Modern French small plates
items.why: A bistro of small plates to share at the front, and a hidden speakeasy room behind the kitchen with a tasting menu that changes nightly. Chef Eloi Spinnler trained at La Tour d'Argent and the Plaza Athénée.
items.whyZh: 前厅是分享式小盘菜小酒馆，厨房后面藏着一间隐秘包厢，品鉴菜单每晚不同。主厨 Eloi Spinnler 曾在 La Tour d'Argent 和 Plaza Athénée 工作。
items.price: Small plates about €10–16; weekday lunch €27; speakeasy tasting menu €55 (lunch, five courses) or €79 (dinner, seven courses)
items.priceZh: 小盘菜约 €10–16；工作日午餐 €27；隐藏包厢品鉴菜单 €55（午餐五道）或 €79（晚餐七道）
items.note: Book online; the speakeasy dinner starts at 20:00.
items.noteZh: 可在网上预订；隐藏包厢晚餐 20:00 开始。

items.name: Orson
items.subtitle: Korean wood-fire cooking
items.why: Esu Lee of Jip cooks Korean flavours over a big wood fire in Saint-Germain: banchan, sashimi of aged fish and grilled fish or meat. The wine list is all French and natural.
items.whyZh: Jip 主厨 Esu Lee 在圣日耳曼开的新店，用大型柴火炉做韩式风味：小菜、熟成鱼生和炭火烤鱼烤肉。酒单全是法国自然酒。
items.price: À la carte at dinner; mains €38–70
items.priceZh: 晚餐单点；主菜 €38–70
items.note: Dinner only; book online.
items.noteZh: 仅供晚餐，可在线预订。

items.name: Osteria Gòto
items.subtitle: Venetian osteria
items.why: A Venetian osteria near Charonne: cicchetti and small plates in the evening, a cheap set lunch and a big terrace on the boulevard.
items.whyZh: Charonne 附近的威尼斯小酒馆：晚上吃 cicchetti 下酒小食和小盘菜，午市套餐便宜，大露台面向林荫大道。
items.price: Lunch €18 (two courses) or €22 (three); evening plates €12–26

items.name: OTORO Omakase
items.subtitle: Omakase sushi
items.why: A newish Japanese omakase place on Rue d'Hauteville; going by the name, a chef's-choice sushi meal. No reviews or menu online yet: check before you go.
items.whyZh: Rue d'Hauteville 上一家较新的日式无菜单料理店，从店名看应是主厨定制的寿司套餐。网上暂时找不到评价或菜单，去之前最好先确认。
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Pango
items.subtitle: Korean home cooking
items.why: A large Korean restaurant near Bibliothèque François-Mitterrand, all home-made: bibimbap with beef tartare, seafood jjamppong, bossam and bulgogi. A mezzanine and private room suit groups.
items.whyZh: 密特朗国家图书馆附近的大型韩国餐厅，菜品全部自制：生牛肉拌饭、海鲜炒码面、菜包肉和韩式烤牛肉。有夹层和包间，适合聚会。
items.price: Mains about €18–24
items.note: Groups can book the mezzanine or private room.
items.noteZh: 团体可预订夹层或包间。

items.name: Plov (Tiquetonne)
items.subtitle: Central Asian (Uzbek)
items.why: Central Asian comfort food near Étienne Marcel: plov (rice slow-cooked with beef, carrots and cumin), samsa pastries, manty dumplings and lagman noodles. A short menu at low prices.
items.whyZh: Étienne Marcel 附近的中亚家常菜：抓饭（牛肉、胡萝卜和孜然慢煮的米饭）、烤包子、蒸饺和拉条子。菜单简短，价格便宜。
items.price: Plov €15; set menu €21 (€17 weekday lunch); sharing menu for two €52
items.priceZh: 抓饭 €15；单人套餐 €21（工作日午餐 €17）；双人分享套餐 €52
items.note: Book online; takeaway too.
items.noteZh: 可在网上订位，也可外带。

items.name: Plov (Voltaire)
items.subtitle: Uzbek
items.why: A simple halal Uzbek restaurant for plov (rice with beef, carrots and chickpeas), baked samsa and steamed manty dumplings. Filling and cheap.
items.whyZh: 简单的清真乌兹别克餐馆，主打抓饭（牛肉、胡萝卜、鹰嘴豆焖饭）、烤包子 samsa 和蒸包子 manty。吃得饱，也便宜。
items.price: Plov €15; set menu €21 (weekday lunch €17); manty €11–17
items.priceZh: 抓饭 €15；套餐 €21（工作日午餐 €17）；manty 蒸包子 €11–17

items.name: Raffiné
items.subtitle: Wagyu steakhouse
items.why: A smart grill house facing the Tuileries, built around aged beef and wagyu cooked over charcoal or in a Josper oven. Big cuts to share, such as a 1.2 kg tomahawk.
items.whyZh: 正对杜乐丽花园的精致烤肉餐厅，主打熟成牛肉和和牛，用炭火或 Josper 炭烤炉烹制。可点 1.2 公斤战斧牛排等大块肉多人分享。
items.price: Steaks €45–107; wagyu burgers €16–28; cuts to share €140–220

items.name: Ralph's
items.subtitle: Classic American
items.why: Ralph Lauren's restaurant inside his Saint-Germain flagship, with a courtyard terrace. Classic American dishes such as burgers and crab cakes; Ralph's Coffee is in the same building.
items.whyZh: Ralph Lauren 圣日耳曼旗舰店内的餐厅，带庭院露台。供应汉堡、蟹饼等经典美式菜；同一栋楼里还有 Ralph's Coffee。
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Restaurant de la Maison de l'Amérique latine
items.subtitle: Modern French
items.why: Seasonal French cooking with Latin American touches, in a grand townhouse on boulevard Saint-Germain. On fine days, ask for the garden terrace.
items.whyZh: 在圣日耳曼大道一座气派宅邸里吃带拉美风味的法式时令菜。天气好时可以坐花园露台。
items.address: Maison de l'Amérique latine, 217 Bd Saint-Germain, 75007 Paris
items.hours: Mon–Fri, lunch and dinner; closed on public holidays
items.hoursZh: 周一至周五午餐和晚餐；公众假期休息
items.price: Lunch menus €46 and €53; dinner menu €58; à la carte mains €32. Plus a €1 day membership per person
items.priceZh: 午餐套餐 €46 和 €53；晚餐套餐 €58；单点主菜 €32。每人另付 €1 当日会员费
items.note: Weekdays only; book online (TheFork) or by phone.
items.noteZh: 仅工作日营业；可通过 TheFork 网上预订或电话预订。

items.name: REYNA
items.subtitle: Modern Filipino
items.why: Erica Paredes cooks Filipino and South-East Asian food with a French touch, as sharing plates in a narrow, busy room. The fried chicken is the dish to order.
items.whyZh: 主厨 Erica Paredes 用法式手法做菲律宾和东南亚风味，以分享菜为主，店面窄小热闹。招牌是炸鸡。
items.price: Sharing plates: starters €14–22, mains €25–39, desserts €10 (2025)
items.note: Online bookings only; they open two weeks ahead.
items.noteZh: 仅接受网上预订，提前两周开放。

items.name: Robert et Louise
items.subtitle: Wood-fire grill
items.why: A rustic Marais institution since 1958, still run by the founders' family. Steaks, lamb and côte de bœuf are grilled over a wood fire in the dining room.
items.whyZh: 1958 年开业的玛黑区老店，乡村风格，至今由创始人家族经营。牛排、羊肉和带骨肋眼都在餐厅里的柴火上现烤。
items.price: Côte de bœuf for two €70; mains €15–36; starters €9–20
items.priceZh: 双人份带骨肋眼牛排 €70；主菜 €15–36；前菜 €9–20
items.note: Book online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 可在网上或电话预订。

items.name: SaltoBar
items.subtitle: Modern Iberian tapas
