items.why: Top Chef finalist Diego Alary’s first restaurant of his own. Iberian tapas and dishes cooked over a wood fire, from tortilla and fideuà to whole turbot, with Spanish and Portuguese wines.
items.whyZh: 《Top Chef》决赛选手 Diego Alary 的第一家个人餐厅。主打伊比利亚风味小食和柴火料理，从西班牙土豆蛋饼、海鲜细面（fideuà）到整条烤多宝鱼，配西班牙和葡萄牙葡萄酒。
items.address: 11 Rue Camille Crespin du Gast, 75011 Paris

items.name: Sam So
items.subtitle: Hand-pulled Korean noodles
items.why: Korean noodles kneaded and pulled by hand every day: beef jajangmyeon, spicy seafood jjamppong and chicken kalguksu. From the group behind Sam Sun, open daily.
items.whyZh: 每天手工揉制拉制的韩式面条：牛肉炸酱面、辣味海鲜炒码面和鸡肉刀切面。与 Sam Sun 同属一个集团，每天营业。
items.price: About €20–30 a head

items.name: SEOK by Mingoo Kang
items.subtitle: Modern Korean
items.why: Mingoo Kang, of three-star Mingles in Seoul, cooks Korean food built on fermented sauces and banchan, with French produce. Share small plates, then mains served with side dishes, in the Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme.
items.whyZh: 首尔三星餐厅 Mingles 的主厨 Mingoo Kang 在巴黎开的第一家店，位于 Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme 酒店。以发酵酱料和小菜为根基，用法国食材做韩餐：先分享小盘，再上配小菜的主菜。
items.price: Six-course guided menu €95; about €100 a head à la carte
items.priceZh: 六道式套餐 €95；单点人均约 €100
items.note: Book online via the website (TheFork).
items.noteZh: 可在官网通过 TheFork 在线预订。

items.name: Sindang Grill
items.subtitle: Korean barbecue
items.why: A Korean grill restaurant in the Passage des Panoramas, the old covered arcade off the Grands Boulevards.
items.whyZh: 位于全景廊街（Passage des Panoramas）的韩式烤肉店，这条老式廊街紧邻林荫大道。
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Sokcho 牛者
items.subtitle: Japanese barbecue
items.why: Japanese barbecue near the Opéra, with cuts from Angus beef to Japanese A5 wagyu, plus sukiyaki. The wagyu set menu is the easy choice.
items.whyZh: 歌剧院附近的日式烤肉店，牛肉从安格斯到日本 A5 和牛都有，还有寿喜烧。想省心就点和牛套餐。
items.price: Wagyu set menu €79.90 (Mon–Thu); à la carte cuts from about €25, Japanese A5 wagyu €59 per 100 g
items.priceZh: 和牛套餐 €79.90（仅周一至周四）；单点肉约 €25 起，日本 A5 和牛每 100 克 €59
items.note: Book online on the restaurant's website.
items.noteZh: 可在餐厅官网在线预订。

items.name: Sushi Hiroshi
items.subtitle: Neighbourhood sushi
items.why: A quiet neighbourhood sushi restaurant near Voltaire, serving sushi, maki and sashimi.
items.whyZh: 伏尔泰站附近一家安静的街区寿司店，供应寿司、卷寿司和刺身。
items.price: About €30–50 a head (from listings)
items.priceZh: 人均约 €30–50（据点评网站）
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Taiyaki Oden
items.subtitle: Oden and taiyaki
items.why: A small Japanese snack spot in Saint-Germain for oden simmered in broth, freshly made taiyaki (sweet or savoury) and bingsu shaved ice.
items.whyZh: 圣日耳曼区的日式小食店，有清汤关东煮、现做鲷鱼烧（甜咸皆有）和 bingsu 刨冰。
items.price: About €10–20 a head

items.name: Takara
items.subtitle: Classic Japanese
items.why: Open since 1958 and said to be the oldest Japanese restaurant in Paris; the room has hardly changed. Known for hot pots such as shabu-shabu and udon-suki, plus sushi and sashimi.
items.whyZh: 1958 年开业，号称巴黎最老的日本餐厅，店里几十年没怎么变。招牌是涮涮锅和乌冬火锅，也有寿司和刺身。
items.price: About €60 a head; hot pots €28–56 (2023 prices)

items.name: Tigermilk
items.subtitle: Mexican-inspired
items.why: The group's first Paris branch, in Sentier: Mexican-inspired tacos, ceviches, quesadillas and grilled meats, with pisco sours and margaritas.
items.whyZh: Tigermilk 在巴黎的第一家店，位于 Sentier 街区。主打墨西哥风味的塔可、酸橘汁腌鱼、芝士薄饼和烤肉，配皮斯科酸酒和玛格丽特。
items.price: About €25–35 a head
items.note: Book online (SevenRooms).
items.noteZh: 可在网上（SevenRooms）预订。

items.name: Tigermilk Canal
items.subtitle: Mexican-inspired
items.why: A lively Mexican-inspired canteen on the Canal Saint-Martin: guacamole, tacos, ceviches and grilled meats, with pisco sours and margaritas. Brunch at weekends.
items.whyZh: 圣马丁运河边热闹的墨西哥风味餐厅，有牛油果酱、塔可、酸橘汁腌鱼和烤肉，配皮斯科酸酒和玛格丽特。周末供应早午餐。
items.price: Tacos €6–6.50 a pair; ceviches €14.50–16; mains €13.50–18.90; desserts €6–7.50
items.note: Book online (SevenRooms).
items.noteZh: 可在网上（SevenRooms）预订。

items.name: Wagyu 1129 (iiniku)
items.subtitle: Wagyu yakiniku
items.why: Japanese wagyu from Gunma that you grill yourself at the table, yakiniku-style. Shabu-shabu is also on the menu.
items.whyZh: 来自日本群马县的和牛，在桌上自己烤，吃法是日式烤肉；也有涮涮锅。
items.price: Wagyu sets €120 (180 g) to €210 (260 g), 2022 prices
items.note: Few tables: book ahead online or by phone.
items.noteZh: 座位不多，建议提前在网上或电话预订。

items.name: Yatai Ramen Pyramides
items.subtitle: Japanese ramen
items.why: A small, lantern-lit ramen bar in the Passage Choiseul, one of five Yatai Ramen shops in Paris. Rich tonkotsu ramen, a vegetarian bowl and home-made gyoza.
items.whyZh: 藏在 Passage Choiseul 拱廊里的小拉面店，挂着灯笼，是 Yatai Ramen 在巴黎的五家店之一。有浓郁的豚骨拉面、素食拉面和自制煎饺。
items.price: Ramen €19.50–20.50; about €20–30 a head with a starter and dessert
items.note: Book on TheFork; the room is small.
items.noteZh: 可在 TheFork 预订；店面很小。

items.name: Zakuro
items.subtitle: Japanese izakaya
items.why: A 14-seat izakaya run by chef Go Sato and his mother, Atsuko Sakamoto. Home-style plates such as karaage, tuna tartare on rice and grilled sea bream, with a good sake and shochu list.
items.whyZh: 只有 14 个座位的居酒屋，由主厨 Go Sato 和母亲 Atsuko Sakamoto 一起经营。供应日式炸鸡、金枪鱼塔塔盖饭、烤鲷鱼等家常菜，清酒和烧酒选择很多。
items.price: About €20–40 a head
items.note: Dinner bookings open 30 days ahead and fill fast; no bookings at lunch.
items.noteZh: 晚餐提前 30 天开放预订，很快订满；午餐不接受预订。

items.name: Zicatela Rex
items.subtitle: Oaxacan Mexican
items.why: A Mexican restaurant by the Grand Rex cinema, cooking dishes from Oaxaca: enchiladas, pozole, tamales and chilaquiles, with margaritas.
items.whyZh: Grand Rex 影院旁的墨西哥餐厅，做瓦哈卡地区的菜：enchiladas、pozole 玉米汤、tamales 和 chilaquiles，配玛格丽特。
items.price: About €20–30 a head
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Bacha Coffee
items.subtitle: Moroccan-style coffee house
items.why: Bacha Coffee's three-floor flagship on the Champs-Élysées, styled like a Moroccan palace. More than 200 Arabica coffees poured from gold pots with whipped cream, plus pastries and light meals.
items.whyZh: Bacha Coffee 在香榭丽舍大道的三层旗舰店，装潢如摩洛哥宫殿。有 200 多款阿拉比卡咖啡，用金色咖啡壶上桌并配鲜奶油，也供应甜点和简餐。

items.name: Bar Nouveau
items.subtitle: Cocktail bar
items.why: A small Art Nouveau cocktail bar in the Marais, No. 15 in The World's 50 Best Bars 2026. French aperitif-style drinks on the ground floor; a 90-minute, six-cocktail sequence downstairs.
items.whyZh: 玛黑区一间新艺术风格的小鸡尾酒吧，2026 年世界 50 佳酒吧排名第 15。一楼主打法式开胃酒风格的调酒，地下室是约 90 分钟、六款鸡尾酒的体验。
items.price: Cocktails about €16–20
items.priceZh: 鸡尾酒约 €16–20
items.note: No bookings: arrive early for a seat.
items.noteZh: 不接受预订：想要座位请早点到。

items.name: Buddy Buddy
items.subtitle: Nut butter coffee bar
items.why: A Brussels-born coffee bar by the Canal Saint-Martin that blends its own organic nut butters into drinks. Try Le Buddy, a peanut butter latte, hot or iced.
items.whyZh: 源自布鲁塞尔的咖啡吧，就在圣马丁运河边，把自家有机坚果酱加进饮品。招牌 Le Buddy 是花生酱拿铁，冷热皆可。

items.name: Café Isaka
items.subtitle: Asian-flavoured ice cream
items.why: A small ice-cream and coffee shop in the Japanese quarter near Rue Sainte-Anne. Ice creams in Asian flavours such as pandan, black sesame and Thai tea, and the house fried ice cream.
items.whyZh: 圣安娜街日本街区里的小冰淇淋咖啡店。冰淇淋有斑斓、黑芝麻、泰式奶茶等亚洲口味，招牌是炸冰淇淋。
items.price: Fried ice cream €6.80; most orders under €15 (2023 prices)
items.priceZh: 炸冰淇淋 €6.80；人均不到 €15（2023 年价格）

items.name: Carré Pain de Mie
items.subtitle: Japanese bread and sandos
items.why: Soft Japanese-style sandwich loaves baked on site, to eat plain, toasted or in sandos and croque monsieur. Good for a quick lunch or a loaf to take away.
items.whyZh: 店内每天现烤日式吐司，可以直接吃、烤着吃，或做成三明治和法式火腿芝士吐司。适合简单吃个午餐，或买一条带走。
items.price: Under €15 a head
items.priceZh: 人均 €15 以内

items.name: Chop Chop Love
items.subtitle: Natural wine bar
items.why: A lively natural-wine bar near Strasbourg–Saint-Denis, from the team behind La Chope des Artistes. Guest chefs take turns in the tiny kitchen, so the short list of plates keeps changing.
items.whyZh: Strasbourg–Saint-Denis 附近热闹的自然酒酒吧，由 La Chope des Artistes 团队开设。小厨房由客座厨师轮流掌勺，几道小菜常换常新。
items.price: Plates €10–20; wine from €6 a glass, bottles €32–45 (2024 prices)

items.name: GRAVE
items.subtitle: Coffee and soft serve
items.why: A small Marais coffee shop with very good milk coffees and dense soft serve in changing flavours, such as coconut and charcoal or kefir.
items.whyZh: 玛黑区的小咖啡馆，奶咖做得很好，还有口味常换、口感浓密的软冰淇淋，比如椰子竹炭、开菲尔。
items.price: Latte €5.80; pastries €3.50–4.50; soft serve €4.50 (2024)

items.name: Il Gelato del Marchese
items.subtitle: Italian gelato
items.why: Natural Italian gelato and sorbets by the Carrefour de l'Odéon, made without colourings or preservatives. The Sicilian croccante (pistachio, almond and honey) is a house favourite.
items.whyZh: 奥德翁路口的意式手工冰淇淋和雪葩，不加色素和防腐剂。招牌是西西里脆糖口味（开心果、杏仁、蜂蜜）。
items.address: 2 Rue de Condé, Carr de l'Odéon, 75006 Paris
items.price: About €5–10 for a cone or cup
items.priceZh: 一个甜筒或一杯约 €5–10

items.name: Le Comptoir Général
items.subtitle: Global sharing plates
items.why: A sprawling bar and restaurant by Canal Saint-Martin, dressed like a film set. Come for rum cocktails and plates to share, then stay for the Caribbean-flavoured party bar.
items.whyZh: 圣马丁运河边一处像电影布景的大型酒吧餐厅。来喝朗姆鸡尾酒、吃分享小盘，饭后再去加勒比风情的派对酒吧。
items.price: Sharing plates €10–17 (two or three each); desserts €8; cocktails €12–14
items.priceZh: 分享小盘 €10–17（每人两三盘）；甜点 €8；鸡尾酒 €12–14
items.note: Book online; smart-casual dress, no sportswear or flip-flops.
items.noteZh: 可在网上预订；着装需整洁，不得穿运动服或人字拖。

items.name: Le Tê
items.subtitle: Taiwanese tea room
items.why: A small Franco-Taiwanese tea room by the Palais-Royal gardens. Milk teas, fruit and flower teas, and Taiwanese egg cakes baked on the spot, for a cheap and easy afternoon break.
items.whyZh: 皇家宫殿花园旁的法式台湾小茶室。奶茶、果茶、花茶，配现烤的台湾鸡蛋糕，适合下午歇歇脚，价格不贵。
items.price: Tea-time sets from €10; drinks €5.80–7.20; six egg cakes €5 (2025 prices)

items.name: Mariage Frères
items.subtitle: French tea house
items.why: The tea merchant's historic Marais shop, wood-panelled and stacked with hundreds of teas. Behind it, a glass-roofed tea room serves lunch, pastries and afternoon tea.
items.whyZh: 巴黎老牌茶商在玛黑区的本店：木质装潢的店里有数百种茶，后面是玻璃顶的茶室，可吃午餐、甜点或下午茶。
items.price: Pastries from €13; afternoon tea €45–65
items.priceZh: 甜点每份 €13 起；下午茶 €45–65
items.note: Busy at weekends. Lunch can be booked by email or phone.
items.noteZh: 周末人多；午餐可通过邮件或电话预订。

items.name: Miyabi Matcha
items.subtitle: Matcha café
items.why: A matcha café near Saint-Lazare station, known for its matcha crème brûlée crêpe.
items.whyZh: 圣拉扎尔车站附近的抹茶咖啡馆，招牌是抹茶焦糖布丁可丽饼。
items.note: Not confirmed recently: check that it is open before you go.
items.noteZh: 近期未能核实：出发前请先确认是否营业。

items.name: Pâtisserie Rayonnance
items.subtitle: French pâtisserie
items.why: A tiny pâtisserie near Cadet run by Yuki Hayato and Lumi Hachiya, both formerly of Pages. Neat tarts, travel cakes and a Black Forest cake, with extra treats on Saturdays.
items.whyZh: Cadet 地铁站附近的小甜品店，由曾在 Pages 工作的 Yuki Hayato 和 Lumi Hachiya 开设。有精致的挞、旅行蛋糕和黑森林蛋糕，周六另有限定甜点。
items.price: Pastries about €7 each
items.priceZh: 甜点每块约 €7
items.note: Order whole cakes by phone at least a day ahead.
items.noteZh: 整只蛋糕需至少提前一天电话预订。

items.name: Sevenly Heart
items.subtitle: Matcha café and bar
items.why: A small, photogenic Marais café known for matcha, red velvet lattes and home-made cakes. In the evening it becomes a bar with wine and cocktails. Often busy.
items.whyZh: 玛黑区一家小而上镜的咖啡馆，以抹茶、红丝绒拿铁和自制蛋糕出名。晚上变成酒吧，供应葡萄酒和鸡尾酒。经常人多。
items.price: Coffee from €3, matcha about €7, cocktails about €13
items.priceZh: 咖啡 €3 起，抹茶约 €7，鸡尾酒约 €13

items.name: Shana
items.subtitle: Israeli small plates
items.why: A candlelit wine bar from Assaf Granit's team, where Jerusalem flavours meet Paris produce. Share a few plates, such as challah with olive oil and cream, over unusual wines.
items.whyZh: Assaf Granit 团队开的烛光葡萄酒吧，耶路撒冷风味遇上巴黎食材。点几样小盘分享，比如配橄榄油和奶油的哈拉面包，再来一杯少见的葡萄酒。
items.note: Evenings only; book online.
items.noteZh: 仅晚间营业，可在网上预订。

items.name: Séréni'Thé 隐庐
items.subtitle: Chinese tea house
items.why: A calm Chinese tea house near the Élysée, with rare Chinese teas, seasonal Chinese pastries and a shop for tea and teaware. You sit on cushions or in armchairs; it is not cheap.
items.whyZh: 爱丽舍宫附近的一家安静中式茶馆（隐庐），供应稀有中国茶和应季中式点心，也出售茶叶和茶具。可以坐在坐垫或扶手椅上，价格不便宜。
items.price: Teas from about €17; tea and a pastry about €30
items.priceZh: 茶约 €17 起；一份茶加一块点心约 €30
items.note: Book a seat or a tea event on the website.
items.noteZh: 可在官网预订座位或茶会活动。

items.name: Tapisserie (Charonne)
items.subtitle: French pâtisserie
items.why: The pâtisserie of the Septime team. Known for croissants, choux with flouve cream, pains aux raisins and seasonal tarts; croissants sell out, so come early.
items.whyZh: Septime 团队开的甜点店，以可颂、黄花茅奶油泡芙、葡萄干面包和时令挞出名。可颂卖得快，最好早点去。

items.name: TSUJIRI Opéra
items.subtitle: Matcha tea house
items.why: The Paris shop of TSUJIRI, a Kyoto tea house founded in 1860, a short walk from Opéra. Go for matcha and other Japanese green teas.
items.whyZh: TSUJIRI 是 1860 年创立于京都的茶铺，这家巴黎门店离歌剧院不远。适合来尝抹茶和其他日本绿茶。

items.name: Wilde's Lounge at L'Hotel
items.subtitle: Hotel cocktail bar
items.why: The sophisticated ground-floor bar of L'Hotel, where Oscar Wilde died. Classic cocktails, each with its history on the menu, plus small plates of cheese and charcuterie.
items.whyZh: L'Hotel 一楼的雅致酒吧，Oscar Wilde 正是在这家酒店去世的。经典鸡尾酒的酒单上写着每款的由来，还有奶酪和冷切肉等小食。
items.price: Cocktails €18–20; tapas €10–15

items.name: Wonderland Patisserie
items.subtitle: Trompe-l'œil pâtisserie
items.why: Rodolphe Groizard's pâtisserie and small tea room near Alésia. His trompe-l'œil cakes look like everyday objects, from cacti to armchairs.
items.whyZh: Rodolphe Groizard 在 Alésia 附近开的甜点店，带一间小茶室。他的错视蛋糕做得像日常物件，从仙人掌到扶手椅都有。

items.name: Yamazaki
items.subtitle: Japanese-French pâtisserie
items.why: A Japanese pâtisserie at La Muette since 1988, part of Yamazaki Baking. French cakes with Japanese touches such as matcha and black sesame, plus light cream puffs.
items.whyZh: 1988 年起开在 La Muette 的日资甜点店，隶属山崎面包。法式蛋糕加入抹茶、黑芝麻等日式风味，奶油泡芙也很轻盈。

items.name: Zia
items.subtitle: Brunch café
items.why: A bright café near École Militaire for brunch: Dutch baby pancakes, avocado toast, burritos, fresh juice and good coffee. No bookings, so come early at weekends.
items.whyZh: 靠近军校（École Militaire）的明亮咖啡馆，主打早午餐：荷兰宝贝松饼、牛油果吐司、墨西哥卷饼、鲜榨果汁和不错的咖啡。不接受预订，周末早点去。
items.price: Brunch dishes €15–17; brunch set €28
items.priceZh: 早午餐主菜 €15–17；早午餐套餐 €28
items.note: No bookings: tables go in order of arrival.
items.noteZh: 不接受预订，按到店顺序入座。
